File Summary
================================================================

Purpose:
--------
This file contains a packed representation of the entire repository's contents.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

File Format:
------------
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A separator line (================)
  b. The file path (File: path/to/file)
  c. Another separator line
  d. The full contents of the file
  e. A blank line

Usage Guidelines:
-----------------
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

Notes:
------
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Line numbers have been added to the beginning of each line
- Security check has been disabled - content may contain sensitive information
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

23: 
24:     public string VlessLink => $"vless://{Uuid}@{DisplayServer}:{Port}?type=tcp&security=reality&pbk={PublicKey}&fp=chrome&sni={Sni}&sid={ShortId}&spx=%2F&flow=xtls-rprx-vision&alpn=h2#SingBox_{IpAddress}";

26: }

34:                 "address": "{{DisplayServer}}",
35:                 "port": {{Port}},
36:                 "users": [{ "id": "{{Uuid}}", "encryption": "none", "flow": "xtls-rprx-vision" }]
37:               }
38:             ]

42:             "security": "reality",

45:               "serverName": "{{Sni}}",

47:               "shortId": "{{ShortId}}",
48:               "spiderX": "/"
49:             }
50:           }
51:         }
52:       ]
53:     }
54:     """;

 1: using KoFFPanel.Domain.Entities;
 2: using KoFFPanel.Application.Interfaces;
 3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 4: 
 5: namespace KoFFPanel.Application.Interfaces.ProtocolBuilders;
 6: 
 7: public interface IProtocolBuilder
 8: {
 9:     string ProtocolType { get; }      // Внутреннее имя (vless, hysteria2, trusttunnel)
10:     string DisplayName { get; }       // Имя для UI в Мастере установки
11:     string TransportType { get; }     // Транспорт "tcp" или "udp" (очень важно для проверки портов!)
12:     int DefaultPort { get; }          // Порт, который умный алгоритм предложит первым
13: 
14:     // Генерация ключей на сервере и создание объекта Inbound для сохранения в БД
15:     Task<ServerInbound> GenerateNewInboundAsync(ISshService ssh, int port);
16: 
17:     // Сборка красивой клиентской ссылки для конкретного юзера
18:     string GenerateClientLink(ServerInbound inbound, string serverIp, string clientUuid, string clientEmail);
19: }

================
File: KoFFPanel.Application/Services/ProtocolFactory.cs
================
 1: using KoFFPanel.Application.Constants;
 2: using KoFFPanel.Application.Interfaces.ProtocolBuilders;
 3: using System;
 4: using System.Collections.Generic;
 5: using System.Linq;
 6: 
 7: namespace KoFFPanel.Application.Services;
 8: 
 9: public sealed class ProtocolFactory
10: {
11:     private readonly IEnumerable<IProtocolBuilder> _builders;
12: 
13:     public ProtocolFactory(IEnumerable<IProtocolBuilder> builders)
14:     {
15:         _builders = builders;
16:     }
17: 
18:     // Умный фильтр: жестко распределяет протоколы по выбранному ядру
19:     public IEnumerable<IProtocolBuilder> GetAvailableProtocols(string coreType)
20:     {
21:         return coreType.ToLower() switch
22:         {
23:             CoreTypes.SingBox => _builders.Where(b =>
24:                 b.ProtocolType.Equals("vless", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
25:                 b.ProtocolType.Equals("hysteria2", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
26:                 b.ProtocolType.Equals("trojan", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
27:                 b.ProtocolType.Equals("shadowsocks", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)),
28: 
29:             CoreTypes.Xray => _builders.Where(b =>
30:                 (b.ProtocolType.Equals("vless", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && b.TransportType == "tcp") ||
31:                 b.ProtocolType.Equals("trojan", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
32:                 b.ProtocolType.Equals("shadowsocks", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)),
33: 
34:             CoreTypes.TrustTunnel => _builders.Where(b =>
35:                 b.ProtocolType.Equals("trusttunnel", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)),
36: 
37:             _ => Enumerable.Empty<IProtocolBuilder>()
38:         };
39:     }
40: 
41:     public IProtocolBuilder? GetBuilder(string protocolType) =>
42:         _builders.FirstOrDefault(b => b.ProtocolType.Equals(protocolType, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
43: }

  1: using KoFFPanel.Application.Interfaces;
  2: using KoFFPanel.Application.Templates;

  5: using System.Text;
  6: using System.Threading.Tasks;

 10: public class SingBoxInstallStrategy : ICoreInstallStrategy
 11: {
 12:     public async Task<(bool Success, string Message, object? Result)> ExecuteFullInstall(
 13:         ISshService ssh,
 14:         string ipAddress,
 15:         int vpnPort,
 16:         string sni,
 17:         string existingUuid = "",
 18:         string existingPrivKey = "",
 19:         string existingPubKey = "",
 20:         string existingShortId = "",
 21:         string customDomain = "",
 22:         string connectionNode = "")
 23:     {
 24:         try
 25:         {
 26:             string prepareScript = $$"""
 27:             export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
 28:             echo "1. Обновление системы..."
 29:             apt-get update -q || true
 30:             apt-get install -y curl jq lsof openssl tar gzip >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 31:             
 32:             echo "2. Остановка конфликтующих служб..."
 33:             systemctl stop sing-box xray v2ray trusttunnel 2>/dev/null || true
 34:             systemctl disable sing-box xray trusttunnel 2>/dev/null || true
 35:             
 36:             echo "3. Очистка порта {{vpnPort}}..."
 37:             PIDS=$(lsof -t -i:{{vpnPort}} || true)
 38:             if [ -n "$PIDS" ]; then kill -9 $PIDS 2>/dev/null || true; fi
 39:             
 40:             echo "4. Определение архитектуры..."
 41:             ARCH=$(uname -m)
 42:             case "$ARCH" in
 43:               x86_64) DL_ARCH="amd64" ;;
 44:               aarch64) DL_ARCH="arm64" ;;
 45:               armv7l) DL_ARCH="armv7" ;;
 46:               *) echo "ERROR_ARCH: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
 47:             esac
 48:             
 49:             echo "5. Поиск версии..."
 50:             TAG=$(curl -sL --connect-timeout 5 https://api.github.com/repos/SagerNet/sing-box/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name 2>/dev/null)
 51:             if [ -z "$TAG" ] || [ "$TAG" == "null" ]; then TAG="v1.13.11"; fi
 52:             
 53:             URL="https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/releases/download/${TAG}/sing-box-${TAG#v}-linux-${DL_ARCH}.tar.gz"
 54:             
 55:             echo "6. Скачивание..."
 56:             curl -sL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 10 -o /tmp/sb.tar.gz "$URL"
 57:             
 58:             if [ ! -s /tmp/sb.tar.gz ]; then
 59:                 echo "ERROR_DOWNLOAD: $URL"
 60:                 exit 1
 61:             fi
 62:             
 63:             echo "7. Распаковка..."
 64:             rm -rf /tmp/sb_extracted && mkdir -p /tmp/sb_extracted
 65:             tar -xzf /tmp/sb.tar.gz -C /tmp/sb_extracted --strip-components=1
 66:             
 67:             if [ ! -f /tmp/sb_extracted/sing-box ]; then
 68:                 echo "ERROR_EXTRACT"
 69:                 exit 1
 70:             fi
 71:             
 72:             mv /tmp/sb_extracted/sing-box /usr/local/bin/
 73:             chmod +x /usr/local/bin/sing-box
 74:             
 75:             echo "8. Верификация..."
 76:             if /usr/local/bin/sing-box version > /dev/null 2>&1; then
 77:                 echo "SUCCESS_PREPARE"
 78:             else
 79:                 echo "ERROR_VERIFY"
 80:                 exit 1
 81:             fi
 82:             
 83:             mkdir -p /etc/sing-box /var/log/sing-box
 84:             rm -rf /tmp/sb.tar.gz /tmp/sb_extracted
 85:             """;
 86: 
 87:             string safeScriptBase64 = Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(prepareScript.Replace("\r", "")));
 88:             var prepResult = await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync($"echo '{safeScriptBase64}' | base64 -d | bash", TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5));
 89: 
 90:             if (prepResult.Contains("ERROR_ARCH", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return (false, $"Ошибка: Архитектура {prepResult} не поддерживается Sing-box.", null);
 91:             if (prepResult.Contains("ERROR_DOWNLOAD", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return (false, $"Ошибка скачивания архива ядра. Проверьте соединение.", null);
 92:             if (!prepResult.Contains("SUCCESS_PREPARE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return (false, $"Сбой инсталлятора.\nВывод: {prepResult.Trim()}", null);
 93: 
 94:             string finalUuid = existingUuid, finalPriv = existingPrivKey, finalPub = existingPubKey, finalSid = existingShortId;
 95: 
 96:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(finalPriv) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(finalPub))
 97:             {
 98:                 string keyGenScript = """
 99:                 KEYS=$(/usr/local/bin/sing-box generate reality-keypair)
100:                 PRIV=$(echo "$KEYS" | grep PrivateKey | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '\r\n')
101:                 PUB=$(echo "$KEYS" | grep PublicKey | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '\r\n')
102:                 SID=$(openssl rand -hex 4)
103:                 UUID=$(/usr/local/bin/sing-box generate uuid)
104:                 echo "$UUID|$PRIV|$PUB|$SID"
105:                 """;
106: 
107:                 string keyGenBase64 = Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(keyGenScript.Replace("\r", "")));
108:                 string keysOutput = await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync($"echo '{keyGenBase64}' | base64 -d | bash", TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30));
109:                 string[] parts = keysOutput.Trim().Split('|');
110: 
111:                 if (parts.Length != 4 || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parts[2]))
112:                     return (false, $"Сбой при генерации ключей Sing-box.\nВывод: {keysOutput}", null);
113: 
114:                 finalUuid = parts[0]; finalPriv = parts[1]; finalPub = parts[2]; finalSid = parts[3];
115:             }
116: 
117:             var result = new SingBoxInstallResult
118:             {
119:                 Uuid = finalUuid,
120:                 PrivateKey = finalPriv,
121:                 PublicKey = finalPub,
122:                 ShortId = finalSid,
123:                 IpAddress = ipAddress,
124:                 Port = vpnPort,
125:                 Sni = sni,
126:                 CustomDomain = customDomain,
127:                 ConnectionNode = connectionNode
128:             };
129: 
130:             string configJson = SingBoxRealityConfigTemplate.GenerateServerConfig(vpnPort, result.Uuid, sni, result.PrivateKey, result.ShortId);
131:             string base64Json = Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(configJson.Replace("\r", "")));
132:             await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync($"echo '{base64Json}' | base64 -d > /etc/sing-box/config.json");
133: 
134:             // ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Добавлено 2>&1, чтобы ловить фатальные ошибки, уходящие в STDERR
135:             var checkConfig = await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync("/usr/local/bin/sing-box check -c /etc/sing-box/config.json 2>&1");
136:             if (checkConfig.Contains("FATAL", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || checkConfig.Contains("error", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
137:             {
138:                 return (false, $"ОШИБКА: Ядро Sing-box отклонило конфиг!\nЛог: {checkConfig.Trim()}", null);
139:             }
140: 
141:             string serviceScript = """
142:             cat << 'EOF' > /etc/systemd/system/sing-box.service
143:             [Unit]
144:             Description=sing-box service
145:             Documentation=https://sing-box.sagernet.org
146:             After=network.target nss-lookup.target network-online.target
147:             
148:             [Service]
149:             CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_ADMIN CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
150:             AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_ADMIN CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
151:             ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/sing-box run -c /etc/sing-box/config.json
152:             ExecReload=/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID
153:             ExecStopPost=/bin/sleep 2
154:             Restart=on-failure
155:             RestartSec=10
156:             LimitNOFILE=infinity
157:             
158:             [Install]
159:             WantedBy=multi-user.target
160:             EOF
161:             systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable sing-box && systemctl restart sing-box
162:             """;
163: 
164:             string serviceBase64 = Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(serviceScript.Replace("\r", "")));
165:             await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync($"echo '{serviceBase64}' | base64 -d | bash", TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30));
166: 
167:             string status = await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync("systemctl is-active sing-box");
168:             if (status.Trim() != "active")
169:             {
170:                 string logs = await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync("journalctl -u sing-box -n 20 --no-pager");
171:                 return (false, $"Служба Sing-box не запустилась.\nЛоги: {logs.Trim()}", null);
172:             }
173: 
174:             return (true, "🚀 Современное ядро Sing-box успешно настроено!", result);
175:         }
176:         catch (Exception ex)
177:         {
178:             return (false, $"Системный сбой инсталлятора Sing-box: {ex.Message}", null);
179:         }
180:     }
181: }

  9: 
 10: public class XrayInstallStrategy : ICoreInstallStrategy
 11: {
 12:     public async Task<(bool Success, string Message, object? Result)> ExecuteFullInstall(
 13:         ISshService ssh,
 14:         string ipAddress,
 15:         int vpnPort,
 16:         string sni,

 56:                 UUID=$(uuidgen)
 57:                 KEYS=$(/usr/local/bin/xray x25519)
 58:                 PRIV=$(echo "$KEYS" | grep -i "Private" | awk '{print $NF}' | tr -d '\r\n')
 59:                 PUB=$(echo "$KEYS" | grep -i "Public" | awk '{print $NF}' | tr -d '\r\n')

 65:                 string[] parts = keysOutput.Trim().Split('|');
 66: 
 67:                 if (parts.Length != 4 || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parts[2]))
 68:                 {
 69:                     return (false, "Критическая ошибка генерации ключей x25519.", null);
 70:                 }
 71: 
 72:                 finalUuid = parts[0];
 73:                 finalPriv = parts[1];
 74:                 finalPub = parts[2];
 75:                 finalSid = parts[3];
 76:             }
 77:

 80:                 Uuid = finalUuid,
 81:                 PrivateKey = finalPriv,

 93:

211:     public string TrafficUsageString
212:     {
213:         get
214:         {
215:             string used = FormatBytes(TrafficUsed);
216:             string limit = TrafficLimit <= 0 ? "∞" : FormatBytes(TrafficLimit);
217:             return $"{used} / {limit}";
218:         }
219:     }
220: 
221:     public string ExpiryString => ExpiryDate.HasValue
222:         ? ExpiryDate.Value.ToString("dd MMM yyyy")
223:         : "Бессрочно";

226: 
227:     public string LastOnlineString => LastOnline.HasValue
228:         ? LastOnline.Value.ToString("dd MMM HH:mm")
229:         : "Никогда";
230: 
231:     private string FormatBytes(long bytes)
232:     {
233:         if (bytes == 0) return "0 B";
234:         string[] suffixes = { "B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB" };
235:         int counter = 0;
236:         decimal number = bytes;
237: 
238:         while (Math.Round(number / 1024) >= 1)
239:         {
240:             number /= 1024;
241:             counter++;
242:         }
243: 
244:         return string.Format("{0:n2} {1}", number, suffixes[counter]);
245:     }

250:     {
251:         PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
252:     }

26:     // ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Маскировочный домен узла для клиентских подключений (например, node.partherhr.ru)
27:     public string? ConnectionNode { get; set; }
28:

30:     public int VpnPort { get; set; } = 443;
31:     public string Uuid { get; set; } = "";
32:     public string PrivateKey { get; set; } = "";
33:     public string PublicKey { get; set; } = "";
34:     public string ShortId { get; set; } = "";
35:     public string Sni { get; set; } = "www.microsoft.com";
36: 
37:     public void MigrateLegacyData()
38:     {
39:         if (!Inbounds.Any() && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(PublicKey))
40:         {
41:             var legacySettings = new
42:             {
43:                 uuid = string.IsNullOrEmpty(Uuid) ? Guid.NewGuid().ToString() : Uuid,
44:                 privateKey = PrivateKey,
45:                 publicKey = PublicKey,
46:                 shortId = ShortId,
47:                 sni = Sni
48:             };
49: 
50:             Inbounds.Add(new ServerInbound
51:             {
52:                 Tag = "vless-reality",
53:                 Protocol = "vless",
54:                 Port = VpnPort > 0 ? VpnPort : 443,
55:                 SettingsJson = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(legacySettings)
56:             });
57: 
58:             CoreType = "xray"; // Старые сервера всегда были на Xray
59:             PublicKey = "";
60:             PrivateKey = "";
61:         }
62:     }
63: }

 4: using System;
 5: using System.IO;
 6: 
 7: namespace KoFFPanel.Infrastructure.Data;
 8: 
 9: public class AppDbContext : DbContext
10: {
11:     public DbSet<VpnClient> Clients { get; set; }
12:     public DbSet<ClientTrafficLog> TrafficLogs { get; set; }
13:     public DbSet<ClientConnectionLog> ConnectionLogs { get; set; }

15: 
16:     // ДОБАВЛЕНА НОВАЯ ТАБЛИЦА ФРОД-СКОРИНГА
17:     public DbSet<ClientBehaviorLog> BehaviorLogs { get; set; }
18: 
19:     public AppDbContext() { }
20: 
21:     public void InitializeDatabaseOptimization()
22:     {
23:         try
24:         {
25:             Database.Migrate();
26:             Database.ExecuteSqlRaw("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;");
27:             Database.ExecuteSqlRaw("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL;");
28:             var result = Database.ExecuteSqlRaw("PRAGMA integrity_check;");
29:         }
30:         catch (Exception ex)
31:         {
32:             System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"[DB-OPTIMIZE-ERROR] Ошибка: {ex.Message}");
33:             throw;
34:         }
35:     }
36: 
37:     public AppDbContext(DbContextOptions<AppDbContext> options) : base(options)
38:     {
39:     }
40: 
41:     protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
42:     {
43:         modelBuilder.Entity<VpnClient>().Ignore(c => c.TrafficUsageString);
44:         modelBuilder.Entity<VpnClient>().Ignore(c => c.ExpiryString);
45:         modelBuilder.Entity<VpnClient>().Ignore(c => c.StatusString);
46:         modelBuilder.Entity<VpnClient>().Ignore(c => c.LastOnlineString);
47:         modelBuilder.Entity<VpnClient>().Ignore(c => c.Country);
48:         modelBuilder.Entity<VpnClient>().Ignore(c => c.AvatarPath);
49: 
50:         modelBuilder.Entity<ClientTrafficLog>().HasIndex(t => new { t.ServerIp, t.Email, t.Date });
51:         modelBuilder.Entity<ClientConnectionLog>().HasIndex(c => new { c.ServerIp, c.Email, c.IpAddress });
52:         modelBuilder.Entity<ClientViolationLog>().HasIndex(v => new { v.ServerIp, v.Email });
53: 
54:         // Индекс для быстрой выборки аналитики за месяц
55:         modelBuilder.Entity<ClientBehaviorLog>().HasIndex(b => new { b.ServerIp, b.Email, b.Date }).IsUnique();
56:     }
57: }

 1: using KoFFPanel.Application.Interfaces;
 2: using KoFFPanel.Application.Interfaces.ProtocolBuilders;
 3: using KoFFPanel.Domain.Entities;
 4: using System;
 5: using System.Text.Json;
 6: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 7: 
 8: namespace KoFFPanel.Infrastructure.Services.ProtocolBuilders;
 9: 
10: public class Hysteria2Builder : IProtocolBuilder
11: {
12:     public string ProtocolType => "hysteria2";
13:     public string DisplayName => "Hysteria 2 (UDP-Bruteforce)";
14:     public string TransportType => "udp";
15:     public int DefaultPort => 8443;
16: 
17:     public async Task<ServerInbound> GenerateNewInboundAsync(ISshService ssh, int port)
18:     {
19:         // Магия генерации самоподписанного TLS-сертификата (нужен для Hy2)
20:         string certPath = $"/etc/sing-box/hy2_{port}.crt";
21:         string keyPath = $"/etc/sing-box/hy2_{port}.key";
22:         
23:         // FOOLPROOF: Гарантируем наличие директории перед генерацией openssl
24:         await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync("mkdir -p /etc/sing-box");
25:         
26:         string certCmd = $"openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout {keyPath} -out {certPath} -days 3650 -subj \"/CN=bing.com\" 2>/dev/null";
27:         await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync(certCmd);
28: 
29:         string obfsPassword = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 10);
30: 
31:         var settings = new
32:         {
33:             certPath = certPath,
34:             keyPath = keyPath,
35:             obfsPassword = obfsPassword,
36:             sni = "bing.com"
37:         };
38: 
39:         return new ServerInbound
40:         {
41:             Tag = $"hysteria2-{port}",
42:             Protocol = ProtocolType,
43:             Port = port,
44:             SettingsJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings)
45:         };
46:     }
47: 
48:     public string GenerateClientLink(ServerInbound inbound, string serverIp, string clientUuid, string clientEmail)
49:     {
50:         var settings = JsonDocument.Parse(inbound.SettingsJson).RootElement;
51:         string sni = settings.GetProperty("sni").GetString() ?? "bing.com";
52:         string obfs = settings.GetProperty("obfsPassword").GetString() ?? "";
53: 
54:         string safeIp = serverIp.Contains(":") && !serverIp.StartsWith("[") ? $"[{serverIp}]" : serverIp;
55:         return $"hy2://{clientUuid}@{safeIp}:{inbound.Port}?sni={sni}&insecure=1&obfs=salamander&obfs-password={obfs}#KoFFPanel-{clientEmail}";
56:     }
57: }

File: KoFFPanel.Infrastructure/Services/ProtocolBuilders/ShadowsocksBuilder.cs
================
 1: using KoFFPanel.Application.Interfaces;
 2: using KoFFPanel.Application.Interfaces.ProtocolBuilders;
 3: using KoFFPanel.Domain.Entities;
 4: using System;
 5: using System.Text;
 6: using System.Text.Json;
 7: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 8: 
 9: namespace KoFFPanel.Infrastructure.Services.ProtocolBuilders;
10: 
11: public partial class ShadowsocksBuilder : IProtocolBuilder
12: {
13:     public string ProtocolType => "shadowsocks";
14:     public string DisplayName => "Shadowsocks (AES-256-GCM)";
15:     public string TransportType => "tcp";
16:     public int DefaultPort => 8388;
17: 
18:     public Task<ServerInbound> GenerateNewInboundAsync(ISshService ssh, int port)
19:     {
20:         // SS не требует сертификатов. Вся магия генерации происходит локально для 100% надежности.
21:         var settings = new
22:         {
23:             method = "aes-256-gcm"
24:         };
25: 
26:         return Task.FromResult(new ServerInbound
27:         {
28:             Tag = $"shadowsocks-{port}",
29:             Protocol = ProtocolType,
30:             Port = port,
31:             SettingsJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings)
32:         });
33:     }
34: 
35:     public string GenerateClientLink(ServerInbound inbound, string serverIp, string clientUuid, string clientEmail)
36:     {
37:         var settings = JsonDocument.Parse(inbound.SettingsJson).RootElement;
38:         string method = settings.GetProperty("method").GetString() ?? "aes-256-gcm";
39: 
40:         string safeIp = serverIp.Contains(":") && !serverIp.StartsWith("[") ? $"[{serverIp}]" : serverIp;
41:         string encodedName = Uri.EscapeDataString($"KoFFPanel-{clientEmail}");
42: 
43:         string credentials = $"{method}:{clientUuid}";
44: 
45:         // ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Используем стандартный Base64 для SIP002 (без замены + на - и / на _)
46:         // Некоторые клиенты (Hiddify) не понимают Base64URL в userinfo.
47:         string base64Creds = Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(credentials));
48: 
49:         return $"ss://{base64Creds}@{safeIp}:{inbound.Port}#{encodedName}";
50:     }
51: }

30:             certPath = certPath,
31:             keyPath = keyPath,
32:             sni = hostname,
33:             masqueEnabled = true
34:         };
35: 
36:         return new ServerInbound
37:         {
38:             Tag = $"trusttunnel-{port}",
39:             Protocol = ProtocolType,
40:             Port = port,
41:             SettingsJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings)
42:         };
43:     }
44: 
45:     public string GenerateClientLink(ServerInbound inbound, string serverIp, string clientUuid, string clientEmail)
46:     {

48:         string hostname = settings.GetProperty("sni").GetString() ?? "vpn.trusttunnel.local";
49:         string safeIp = serverIp.Contains(":") && !serverIp.StartsWith("[") ? $"[{serverIp}]" : serverIp;

51:         // Генерируем идеальный рабочий клиентский TOML-конфиг
52:         return $@"loglevel = ""info""

55: post_quantum_group_enabled = true
56: exclusions = []
57:

17:     public async Task<ServerInbound> GenerateNewInboundAsync(ISshService ssh, int port)
18:     {
19:         string keyCmd = "if [ -f /usr/local/bin/sing-box ]; then /usr/local/bin/sing-box generate reality-keypair; elif command -v sing-box >/dev/null 2>&1; then sing-box generate reality-keypair; else /usr/local/bin/xray x25519; fi";
20:         string keypairOutput = await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync(keyCmd);
21: 
22:         string privateKey = "";
23:         string publicKey = "";
24: 
25:         var lines = keypairOutput.Split(new[] { '\n', '\r' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
26:         foreach (var line in lines)
27:         {
28:             if (line.Contains("Private", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
29:                 privateKey = line.Split(':')[1].Trim();
30: 
31:             if (line.Contains("Public", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
32:                 publicKey = line.Split(':')[1].Trim();
33:         }
34: 
35:         string shortId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 16);
36: 
37:         var settings = new
38:         {
39:             privateKey = privateKey,
40:             publicKey = publicKey,
41:             shortId = shortId,
42:             sni = "google.com"
43:         };
44: 
45:         return new ServerInbound
46:         {
47:             Tag = $"vless-reality-{port}",
48:             Protocol = ProtocolType,
49:             Port = port,
50:             SettingsJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings)
51:         };
52:     }

63:         // ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Добавлен alpn=h2 для Hiddify 4.1.1
64:         return $"vless://{clientUuid}@{safeIp}:{inbound.Port}?type=tcp&security=reality&pbk={pubKey}&fp=chrome&sni={sni}&sid={shortId}&spx=%2F&flow=xtls-rprx-vision&alpn=h2#KoFFPanel-{clientEmail}";

  1: using KoFFPanel.Application.Interfaces;

 14: public class AntiFraudService : IAntiFraudService
 15: {
 16:     private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
 17:     private readonly IAppLogger _logger;
 18: 
 19:     private static readonly Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> _dailyAsns = new();
 20:     private static readonly Dictionary<string, string> _lastCountryCode = new();
 21:     private static readonly Dictionary<string, DateTime> _lastCountryTime = new();
 22: 
 23:     public AntiFraudService(IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory, IAppLogger logger)
 24:     {
 25:         _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
 26:         _logger = logger;
 27:     }
 28: 
 29:     public async Task<(bool IsFraud, string Reason)> EvaluateClientAsync(string serverIp, VpnClient client, string currentIp, long trafficDelta, CancellationToken token = default)
 30:     {
 31:         if (!client.IsAntiFraudEnabled) return (false, "");
 32:         string email = client.Email ?? "Unknown";
 33: 
 34:         using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
 35:         var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>();
 36: 
 37:         var today = DateTime.Today;
 38:         var log = await db.BehaviorLogs.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.ServerIp == serverIp && x.Email == email && x.Date == today, token);
 39: 
 40:         if (log == null)
 41:         {
 42:             log = new ClientBehaviorLog { ServerIp = serverIp, Email = email, Date = today, RiskScore = 0 };
 43:             db.BehaviorLogs.Add(log);
 44:             ClearInMemCachesForNewDay(email);
 45:         }
 46: 
 47:         UpdateMetrics(log, client, currentIp, trafficDelta);
 48:         CalculateRiskScore(log);
 49: 
 50:         await db.SaveChangesAsync(token);
 51: 
 52:         if (log.RiskScore >= 100)
 53:         {
 54:             return (true, $"ФРОД 100%: Сессий={log.MaxConcurrentSessions}, ASN={log.UniqueAsnCount}, GeoJumps={log.GeoJumpsCount}");
 55:         }
 56: 
 57:         return (false, "");
 58:     }
 59: 
 60:     private void UpdateMetrics(ClientBehaviorLog log, VpnClient client, string currentIp, long trafficDelta)
 61:     {
 62:         string email = log.Email;
 63: 
 64:         if (client.ActiveConnections > log.MaxConcurrentSessions)
 65:             log.MaxConcurrentSessions = client.ActiveConnections;
 66: 
 67:         string subnetAsn = GetMockAsnFromIp(currentIp);
 68:         if (!_dailyAsns.ContainsKey(email)) _dailyAsns[email] = new HashSet<string>();
 69:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(subnetAsn) && _dailyAsns[email].Add(subnetAsn))
 70:         {
 71:             log.UniqueAsnCount = _dailyAsns[email].Count;
 72:         }
 73: 
 74:         // Вызов нового, защищенного метода проверки геолокации
 75:         UpdateGeoMetrics(log, email, client.Country);
 76: 
 77:         if (trafficDelta > 1073741824L)
 78:             log.BytesUsedSpike += trafficDelta;
 79:     }
 80: 
 81:     private void UpdateGeoMetrics(ClientBehaviorLog log, string email, string? rawCountry)
 82:     {
 83:         string curCode = GetValidCountryCode(rawCountry);
 84: 
 85:         // Если страна не определилась (например, мобильный интернет без Geo-данных), просто игнорируем
 86:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(curCode)) return;
 87: 
 88:         // Если это первое подключение юзера, просто запоминаем его страну
 89:         if (!_lastCountryCode.TryGetValue(email, out string? lastCode) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(lastCode))
 90:         {
 91:             _lastCountryCode[email] = curCode;
 92:             _lastCountryTime[email] = DateTime.Now;
 93:             return;
 94:         }
 95: 
 96:         // Если страна РЕАЛЬНО сменилась на другую валидную страну
 97:         if (lastCode != curCode)
 98:         {
 99:             if (_lastCountryTime.TryGetValue(email, out DateTime lastTime) && (DateTime.Now - lastTime).TotalHours < 2)
100:             {
101:                 log.GeoJumpsCount++;
102:                 _logger.Log("ANTIFRAUD", $"Зафиксирован GeoJump для {email}: {lastCode} -> {curCode}");
103:             }
104:             _lastCountryCode[email] = curCode;
105:         }
106: 
107:         // Всегда обновляем время последней активности для этой страны
108:         _lastCountryTime[email] = DateTime.Now;
109:     }
110: 
111:     private string GetValidCountryCode(string? rawCountry)
112:     {
113:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawCountry)) return "";
114: 
115:         string code = rawCountry.Trim();
116:         if (code.Length >= 2) code = code.Substring(code.Length - 2).ToUpperInvariant();
117: 
118:         // Исключаем пустые значения, анонимные прокси и небуквенные символы
119:         if (code == "??" || code == "A1" || code == "O1" || !code.All(char.IsLetter))
120:             return "";
121: 
122:         return code;
123:     }
124: 
125:     private void CalculateRiskScore(ClientBehaviorLog log)
126:     {
127:         int score = 0;
128: 
129:         if (log.MaxConcurrentSessions > 8) score += (log.MaxConcurrentSessions - 8) * 10;
130:         if (log.UniqueAsnCount > 3) score += (log.UniqueAsnCount - 3) * 20;
131:         if (log.GeoJumpsCount > 0) score += log.GeoJumpsCount * 80;
132:         if (log.BytesUsedSpike > 0) score += 30;
133: 
134:         log.RiskScore = score > 100 ? 100 : score;
135:     }
136: 
137:     private string GetMockAsnFromIp(string ip)
138:     {
139:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ip)) return "";
140:         var parts = ip.Split('.');
141:         return parts.Length == 4 ? $"AS_{parts[0]}.{parts[1]}" : "AS_IPv6";
142:     }
143: 
144:     public async Task<List<ClientBehaviorLog>> GetMonthlyBehaviorAsync(string serverIp, string email, CancellationToken token = default)
145:     {
146:         using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
147:         var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>();
148: 
149:         var limitDate = DateTime.Today.AddDays(-30);
150:         var rawLogs = await db.BehaviorLogs.AsNoTracking().Where(x => x.ServerIp == serverIp && x.Email == email).ToListAsync(token);
151: 
152:         return rawLogs.Where(x => x.Date >= limitDate).OrderByDescending(x => x.Date).ToList();
153:     }
154: 
155:     public async Task ExecuteMonthlyRetentionPolicyAsync(CancellationToken token = default)
156:     {
157:         using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
158:         var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>();
159: 
160:         var thresholdDate = DateTime.Today.AddDays(-30);
161:         var oldLogs = await db.BehaviorLogs.ToListAsync(token);
162:         var toRemove = oldLogs.Where(x => x.Date < thresholdDate).ToList();
163: 
164:         if (toRemove.Any())
165:         {
166:             db.BehaviorLogs.RemoveRange(toRemove);
167:             await db.SaveChangesAsync(token);
168:             _logger.Log("ANTIFRAUD-CLEANUP", $"Удалено {toRemove.Count} устаревших скоринг-записей.");
169:         }
170:     }
171: 
172:     public async Task ResetDailyRiskAsync(string serverIp, string email, CancellationToken token = default)
173:     {
174:         using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
175:         var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>();
176: 
177:         var today = DateTime.Today;
178:         var log = await db.BehaviorLogs.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.ServerIp == serverIp && x.Email == email && x.Date == today, token);
179: 
180:         if (log != null)
181:         {
182:             // Полный сброс метрик за день
183:             log.RiskScore = 0;
184:             log.MaxConcurrentSessions = 0;
185:             log.UniqueAsnCount = 0;
186:             log.GeoJumpsCount = 0;
187:             log.BytesUsedSpike = 0;
188: 
189:             await db.SaveChangesAsync(token);
190: 
191:             // Очищаем кэши в памяти, чтобы прыжки не засчитались сразу после сброса
192:             _dailyAsns.Remove(email);
193:             _lastCountryCode.Remove(email);
194:             _logger.Log("ANTIFRAUD-RESET", $"Риск-скоринг для {email} полностью сброшен администратором.");
195:         }
196:     }
197:

199:     {
200:         _dailyAsns.Remove(email);

 1: using KoFFPanel.Application.Interfaces;
 2: using System;
 3: using System.IO;
 4: 
 5: namespace KoFFPanel.Infrastructure.Services;
 6: 
 7: public class AppLogger : IAppLogger
 8: {
 9:     private readonly string _logDir;
10:     private readonly string _logFile;
11:     private readonly string _terminalLogFile;
12:     private readonly string _botLogFile; // Добавили переменную для файла бота
13: 
14:     public AppLogger()
15:     {
16:         _logDir = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "Logs");
17:         if (!Directory.Exists(_logDir))
18:         {
19:             Directory.CreateDirectory(_logDir);
20:         }
21: 
22:         _logFile = Path.Combine(_logDir, "app_analytics.log");
23:         _terminalLogFile = Path.Combine(_logDir, "terminal.log");
24: 
25:         // ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Создаем выделенный лог для Telegram Бота
26:         _botLogFile = Path.Combine(_logDir, "BOT.log");
27: 
28:         Log("SESSION", "\n====================== СТАРТ СЕССИИ ======================");
29:     }
30: 
31:     public void Log(string module, string message)
32:     {
33:         try
34:         {
35:             string logEntry = $"[{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}] [{module}] {message}\n";
36: 
37:             // Умная маршрутизация логов
38:             if (module.StartsWith("TERM") || module.StartsWith("SSH"))
39:             {
40:                 File.AppendAllText(_terminalLogFile, logEntry);
41:             }
42:             else if (module.StartsWith("BOT")) // Все логи интеграции летят сюда
43:             {
44:                 File.AppendAllText(_botLogFile, logEntry);
45:             }
46:             else
47:             {
48:                 File.AppendAllText(_logFile, logEntry);
49:             }
50:         }
51:         catch { /* Игнорируем ошибки ввода-вывода, чтобы не крашнуть панель */ }
52:     }
53: }

 27:     {
 28:         if (!trafficDeltas.Any() && !connections.Any() && !violations.Any()) return;

 83:     public async Task CleanupOldLogsAsync()
 84:     {
 85:         using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
 86:         var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>();
 87: 
 88:         // Унифицируем срок хранения - ровно 30 дней для всего.

 90: 
 91:         try
 92:         {

100:             db.ConnectionLogs.RemoveRange(connToRemove);
101:

104:             db.ViolationLogs.RemoveRange(violToRemove);
105: 
106:             if (trafficToRemove.Any() || connToRemove.Any() || violToRemove.Any())
107:             {
108:                 await db.SaveChangesAsync();
109:                 _logger.Log("ANALYTICS-CLEANUP", $"♻️ Очистка завершена. Удалено: Трафик({trafficToRemove.Count}), IP({connToRemove.Count}), Нарушения({violToRemove.Count}).");
110:             }
111:         }
112:         catch (Exception ex)

154:                 ServerInbound inboundDb;

190:             // Выбираем ТОЛЬКО те порты, которые мы реально устанавливаем прямо сейчас.
191:             // Это гарантирует, что мы не убьем соседние живые ядра (SingBox/Xray).
192:             var deployingPorts = protocols.Select(p => p.Port).Distinct().ToList();
193: 
194:             foreach (var port in deployingPorts)

199:             {sudoPrefix}fuser -k -9 {port}/udp 2>/dev/null || true

203:                 await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync(killCmd, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30));
204:             }
205: 
206:             // === УМНЫЙ АЛГОРИТМ: Изолированная валидация конфигов ===
207:             string checkCmd = "";
208:             if (coreName == "sing-box")
209:             {
210:                 checkCmd = $"{sudoPrefix}sing-box check -c /etc/sing-box/config.json 2>&1";

217:             }
218:             else

221:             }
222:

224: 
225:             if (checkRes.ToLower().Contains("error") || checkRes.ToLower().Contains("fatal"))

241:

244: 
245:             if (status != "active")
246:             {
247:                 string errorLogs = await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync($"{sudoPrefix}journalctl -u {coreName} -n 50 --no-pager");
248:                 await LogStep($"КРИТИЧЕСКИЙ СБОЙ: Сервис {coreName} имеет статус {status}!");
249:                 await LogStep($"ЛОГИ ОШИБОК:\n{errorLogs}");

259:             return (false, ex.Message);

263:     private async Task SafeOpenPortAsync(ISshService ssh, int port, string protocol, string sudoPrefix)
264:     {
265:         // ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Жестко вставляем ACCEPT на ПЕРВУЮ позицию в INPUT, чтобы обойти любой UFW/Firewalld
266:         string cmd = $@"
267: if command -v ufw >/dev/null 2>&1; then {sudoPrefix}ufw allow {port}/tcp && {sudoPrefix}ufw allow {port}/udp || true; fi
268: if command -v firewall-cmd >/dev/null 2>&1; then {sudoPrefix}firewall-cmd --add-port={port}/tcp --permanent && {sudoPrefix}firewall-cmd --reload || true; fi
269: {sudoPrefix}iptables -I INPUT 1 -p tcp --dport {port} -j ACCEPT || true
270: {sudoPrefix}iptables -I INPUT 1 -p udp --dport {port} -j ACCEPT || true";
271: 
272:         cmd += $@"
273: {sudoPrefix}sh -c 'iptables-save > /etc/iptables/rules.v4' 2>/dev/null || true";
274: 
275:         await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync(cmd);
276:     }

278:     private async Task<(bool IsSuccess, string Log)> InstallXrayInternalAsync(ISshService ssh, string targetVersion, string sudoPrefix)
279:     {
280:         string script = @"
281: apt-get update -q && apt-get install -y curl wget unzip jq >/dev/null 2>&1
282: DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/XTLS/Xray-core/releases/latest | jq -r "".assets[] | select(.name == \""Xray-linux-64.zip\"") | .browser_download_url"")
283: if [ -z ""$DOWNLOAD_URL"" ]; then echo 'FAIL_INSTALL'; exit 1; fi
284: rm -rf /tmp/xray_install && mkdir -p /tmp/xray_install && cd /tmp/xray_install
285: wget -q ""$DOWNLOAD_URL"" -O xray.zip
286: unzip -o xray.zip >/dev/null
287: chmod +x xray
288: mv xray /usr/local/bin/xray
289: if command -v xray >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'SUCCESS_INSTALLED'; else echo 'FAIL_INSTALL'; fi
290: cd /tmp && rm -rf /tmp/xray_install
291: ".Replace("\r", "");
292: 
293:         string b64 = Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(script));
294:         string log = await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync($"echo '{b64}' | base64 -d | {sudoPrefix}bash", TimeSpan.FromMinutes(3));
295:         return (log.Contains("SUCCESS_INSTALLED") || log.Contains("installed") || log.Contains("already"), log);
296:     }

298:     private async Task<(bool IsSuccess, string Log)> InstallSingBoxInternalAsync(ISshService ssh, string targetVersion, string sudoPrefix)
299:     {
300:         string script = @"
301: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
302: # Делаем обновление некритичным, так как репозитории могут временно сбоить
303: apt-get update -q || true
304: apt-get install -y curl wget tar jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
305: 
306: ARCH=$(uname -m)
307: case ""$ARCH"" in
308:     x86_64) DL_ARCH=""amd64"" ;;
309:     aarch64) DL_ARCH=""arm64"" ;;
310:     *) echo ""FAIL_ARCH: $ARCH""; exit 1 ;;
311: esac

384:     private async Task DeployTrustTunnelConfigAsync(ISshService ssh, VpnProfile profile, string sudoPrefix, List<(IProtocolBuilder Builder, int Port, string? TtUsername, string? TtPassword)> protocols)
385:     {
386:         var inbound = profile.Inbounds.FirstOrDefault(i => i.Protocol.ToLower() == "trusttunnel");
387:         if (inbound == null) return;
388:         var settingsNode = JsonNode.Parse(inbound.SettingsJson) as JsonObject;
389:         string sni = settingsNode?["sni"]?.ToString() ?? "vpn.endpoint";
390: 
391:         // Получаем логин из мастера (обычно ADMIN)
392:         var ttProtocolInfo = protocols.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Builder.ProtocolType.ToLower() == "trusttunnel");
393:         string username = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ttProtocolInfo.TtUsername) ? "ADMIN" : ttProtocolInfo.TtUsername;
394: 
395:         string realPassword = ""; // Здесь будет храниться безопасный Uuid
396: 
397:         // Умный алгоритм работы с БД: получаем или создаем пользователя БЕЗ поломки Uuid
398:         using (var db = new KoFFPanel.Infrastructure.Data.AppDbContext())
399:         {
400:             var adminClient = db.Clients.FirstOrDefault(c => c.ServerIp == profile.IpAddress && c.Email == username);
401:             if (adminClient == null)
402:             {
403:                 // Если пользователя нет, создаем строго с правильным UUID
404:                 adminClient = new VpnClient
405:                 {
406:                     Email = username,
407:                     Uuid = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
408:                     ServerIp = profile.IpAddress!,
409:                     IsTrustTunnelEnabled = true,
410:                     IsActive = true,
411:                     IsVlessEnabled = false,
412:                     IsHysteria2Enabled = false,
413:                     TrafficLimit = 0
414:                 };
415:                 db.Clients.Add(adminClient);
416:             }
417:             else
418:             {
419:                 // Если пользователь есть - просто активируем ему TrustTunnel. 
420:                 // Uuid НЕ ТРОГАЕМ, чтобы не сломать SingBox/VLESS!
421:                 adminClient.IsTrustTunnelEnabled = true;
422:             }
423: 
424:             await db.SaveChangesAsync();
425: 
426:             // Забираем системный Uuid для использования в качестве пароля TrustTunnel
427:             realPassword = adminClient.Uuid;
428:         }
429: 
430:         // Сохраняем правильный пароль в SettingsJson, чтобы интерфейс кабинета показывал правду
431:         if (settingsNode != null)
432:         {
433:             settingsNode["username"] = username;
434:             settingsNode["password"] = realPassword;
435:             inbound.SettingsJson = settingsNode.ToJsonString();
436:         }
437: 
438:         // Генерация ТОЧНЫХ и полных конфигураций через официальный мастер
439:         await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync($"{sudoPrefix}mkdir -p /opt/trusttunnel2");
440:         string setupCmd = $@"{sudoPrefix}cd /opt/trusttunnel2 && {sudoPrefix}./setup_wizard -m non-interactive -a 0.0.0.0:{inbound.Port} -c {username}:{realPassword} -n {sni} --lib-settings vpn.toml --hosts-settings hosts.toml --cert-type self-signed";
441:         await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync(setupCmd);
442: 
443:         string serviceData = @"[Unit]
444: Description=TrustTunnel VPN Service (Custom Port 5443)
445: After=network.target
446: 
447: [Service]
448: Type=simple
449: User=root
450: WorkingDirectory=/opt/trusttunnel2
451: ExecStart=/opt/trusttunnel2/trusttunnel_endpoint vpn.toml hosts.toml
452: Restart=on-failure
453: RestartSec=5
454: LimitNOFILE=65536
455: 
456: [Install]
457: WantedBy=multi-user.target";
458: 
459:         await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync($"echo '{Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(serviceData.Replace("\r", "")))}' | base64 -d | {sudoPrefix}tee /etc/systemd/system/trusttunnel.service > /dev/null");
460:         await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync($"{sudoPrefix}systemctl daemon-reload");
461:     }

503: Description={bin} Service

514: LimitNOFILE=infinity
515: 
516: [Install]
517: WantedBy=multi-user.target";

 1: using KoFFPanel.Application.Interfaces;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
 3: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 4: using System;
 5: using System.IO;
 6: using System.Linq;
 7: using System.Threading;
 8: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 9: 
10: namespace KoFFPanel.Infrastructure.Services;
11: 
12: /// <summary>
13: /// Сервис для автоматического резервного копирования базы данных перед запуском приложения.
14: /// Реализует паттерн Zero Trust: копия делается ДО того, как EF Core начнет работу.
15: /// </summary>
16: public class DatabaseBackupService : IHostedLifecycleService, IDatabaseBackupService
17: {
18:     private readonly ILogger<DatabaseBackupService> _logger;
19:     private const int MaxBackupCount = 7;
20: 
21:     public DatabaseBackupService(ILogger<DatabaseBackupService> logger)
22:     {
23:         _logger = logger;
24:     }
25: 
26:     // Реализация IDatabaseBackupService для совместимости
27:     public async Task CreateBackupAsync()
28:     {
29:         await PerformBackupAsync();
30:     }
31: 
32:     public Task StartingAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
33:     {
34:         return PerformBackupAsync();
35:     }
36: 
37:     private Task PerformBackupAsync()
38:     {
39:         try
40:         {
41:             string dbPath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "koffpanel_users.db");
42:             if (!File.Exists(dbPath)) return Task.CompletedTask;
43: 
44:             string backupDir = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "Backups");
45:             if (!Directory.Exists(backupDir)) Directory.CreateDirectory(backupDir);
46: 
47:             // Очистка старых бэкапов
48:             var oldBackups = new DirectoryInfo(backupDir)
49:                 .GetFiles("*.bak")
50:                 .OrderByDescending(f => f.CreationTime)
51:                 .Skip(MaxBackupCount);
52: 
53:             foreach (var file in oldBackups) file.Delete();
54: 
55:             // Создание нового бэкапа
56:             string timestamp = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss");
57:             string backupPath = Path.Combine(backupDir, $"koffpanel_{timestamp}.bak");
58: 
59:             File.Copy(dbPath, backupPath, true);
60:             _logger.LogInformation($"[DB-BACKUP] Создана резервная копия: {backupPath}");
61:         }
62:         catch (Exception ex)
63:         {
64:             _logger.LogError($"[DB-BACKUP-ERROR] Ошибка при создании бэкапа: {ex.Message}");
65:         }
66: 
67:         return Task.CompletedTask;
68:     }
69: 
70:     public Task StartAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken) => Task.CompletedTask;
71:     public Task StartedAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken) => Task.CompletedTask;
72:     public Task StoppingAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken) => Task.CompletedTask;
73:     public Task StopAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken) => Task.CompletedTask;
74:     public Task StoppedAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken) => Task.CompletedTask;
75: }

File: KoFFPanel.Infrastructure/Services/LogBufferService.cs
================
  1: using KoFFPanel.Domain.Entities;
  2: using KoFFPanel.Infrastructure.Data;
  3: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
  4: using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
  5: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  6: using System;
  7: using System.Collections.Generic;
  8: using System.Threading;
  9: using System.Threading.Channels;
 10: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 11: 
 12: namespace KoFFPanel.Infrastructure.Services;
 13: 
 14: public record VpnLogEntry(string ServerIp, Dictionary<string, long> TrafficDeltas, List<(string Email, string Ip, string Country)> Connections, List<(string Email, string ViolationType)> Violations);
 15: 
 16: /// <summary>
 17: /// Асинхронный буфер для логов. Собирает данные в очередь и записывает в БД пачками,
 18: /// предотвращая блокировки SQLite при высокой нагрузке.
 19: /// </summary>
 20: public class LogBufferService : BackgroundService
 21: {
 22:     private readonly Channel<VpnLogEntry> _logChannel;
 23:     private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
 24:     private readonly ILogger<LogBufferService> _logger;
 25: 
 26:     public LogBufferService(IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory, ILogger<LogBufferService> logger)
 27:     {
 28:         _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
 29:         _logger = logger;
 30:         // Ограниченная очередь на 10 000 записей, чтобы не переполнить память
 31:         _logChannel = Channel.CreateBounded<VpnLogEntry>(new BoundedChannelOptions(10000) { FullMode = BoundedChannelFullMode.Wait });
 32:     }
 33: 
 34:     public bool TryWrite(VpnLogEntry entry) => _logChannel.Writer.TryWrite(entry);
 35: 
 36:     protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
 37:     {
 38:         _logger.LogInformation("[LOG-BUFFER] Сервис буферизации логов запущен.");
 39: 
 40:         while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
 41:         {
 42:             try
 43:             {
 44:                 // Ждем появления данных в канале
 45:                 if (await _logChannel.Reader.WaitToReadAsync(stoppingToken))
 46:                 {
 47:                     // Делаем небольшую паузу, чтобы собрать пачку данных (Batching)
 48:                     await Task.Delay(5000, stoppingToken);
 49: 
 50:                     var entries = new List<VpnLogEntry>();
 51:                     while (_logChannel.Reader.TryRead(out var entry))
 52:                     {
 53:                         entries.Add(entry);
 54:                         if (entries.Count >= 500) break; // Лимит пачки за один раз
 55:                     }
 56: 
 57:                     if (entries.Count > 0)
 58:                     {
 59:                         await ProcessBatchAsync(entries);
 60:                     }
 61:                 }
 62:             }
 63:             catch (OperationCanceledException) { break; }
 64:             catch (Exception ex)
 65:             {
 66:                 _logger.LogError($"[LOG-BUFFER-ERROR] {ex.Message}");
 67:                 await Task.Delay(5000, stoppingToken);
 68:             }
 69:         }
 70:     }
 71: 
 72:     private async Task ProcessBatchAsync(List<VpnLogEntry> entries)
 73:     {
 74:         using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
 75:         var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>();
 76:         var today = DateTime.Today;
 77: 
 78:         _logger.LogDebug($"[LOG-BUFFER] Обработка пачки из {entries.Count} запросов на лог.");
 79: 
 80:         foreach (var entry in entries)
 81:         {
 82:             // 1. Трафик
 83:             foreach (var t in entry.TrafficDeltas)
 84:             {
 85:                 var log = await Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.EntityFrameworkQueryableExtensions.FirstOrDefaultAsync(
 86:                     db.TrafficLogs, x => x.ServerIp == entry.ServerIp && x.Email == t.Key && x.Date == today);
 87: 
 88:                 if (log != null) log.BytesUsed += t.Value;
 89:                 else db.TrafficLogs.Add(new ClientTrafficLog { ServerIp = entry.ServerIp, Email = t.Key, Date = today, BytesUsed = t.Value });
 90:             }
 91: 
 92:             // 2. Подключения
 93:             foreach (var c in entry.Connections)
 94:             {
 95:                 var log = await Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.EntityFrameworkQueryableExtensions.FirstOrDefaultAsync(
 96:                     db.ConnectionLogs, x => x.ServerIp == entry.ServerIp && x.Email == c.Email && x.IpAddress == c.Ip);
 97: 
 98:                 if (log != null)
 99:                 {
100:                     log.LastSeen = DateTime.Now;
101:                     if (log.Country == "??" && c.Country != "??") log.Country = c.Country;
102:                 }
103:                 else db.ConnectionLogs.Add(new ClientConnectionLog { ServerIp = entry.ServerIp, Email = c.Email, IpAddress = c.Ip, Country = c.Country, FirstSeen = DateTime.Now, LastSeen = DateTime.Now });
104:             }
105: 
106:             // 3. Нарушения
107:             foreach (var v in entry.Violations)
108:             {
109:                 db.ViolationLogs.Add(new ClientViolationLog { ServerIp = entry.ServerIp, Email = v.Email, Date = DateTime.Now, ViolationType = v.ViolationType });
110:             }
111:         }
112: 
113:         try
114:         {
115:             await db.SaveChangesAsync();
116:         }
117:         catch (Exception ex)
118:         {
119:             _logger.LogError($"[LOG-BUFFER-DB-ERROR] Ошибка записи пачки: {ex.Message}");
120:         }
121:     }
122: }

 34:     public List<VpnProfile> LoadProfiles()
 35:     {
 36:         if (!File.Exists(_dbFilePath)) return new List<VpnProfile>();
 37:         try

 50:                     try
 51:                     {
 52:                         p.Password = DecryptString(p.Password.Substring(4), masterKey);
 53:                     }
 54:                     catch { p.Password = ""; }
 55:                 }
 56:                 else if (p.Password.StartsWith("DPAPI:", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 57:                 {
 58:                     // Оставляем пустой пароль для старых DPAPI записей, т.к. мы ушли от привязки к Windows
 59:                     p.Password = "";
 60:                 }
 61:             }
 62:             return profiles;
 63:         }
 64:         catch { return new List<VpnProfile>(); }
 65:     }
 66: 
 67:     // === 2026 MODERNIZATION: Шифрование через Master Password ===
 68:     public void SaveProfiles(List<VpnProfile> profiles)
 69:     {
 70:         Directory.CreateDirectory(_appDataFolder);
 71: 
 72:         var jsonCopy = JsonSerializer.Serialize(profiles);
 73:         var safeProfiles = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<VpnProfile>>(jsonCopy) ?? new List<VpnProfile>();
 74: 
 75:         string masterKey = MasterKeyService.Instance.GetMasterPassword();
 76: 
 77:         foreach (var p in safeProfiles)
 78:         {
 79:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.Password) && !p.Password.StartsWith("AES:", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 80:             {
 81:                 try
 82:                 {
 83:                     p.Password = "AES:" + EncryptString(p.Password, masterKey);
 84:                 }
 85:                 catch { }
 86:             }
 87:         }
 88: 
 89:         string finalJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(safeProfiles, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true });
 90:         File.WriteAllText(_dbFilePath, finalJson);
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     private string EncryptString(string text, string key)
 94:     {
 95:         // В 2026 используем простой и надежный AES для локальных паролей
 96:         using var aes = Aes.Create();
 97:         var keyBytes = System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.HashData(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(key));
 98:         aes.Key = keyBytes;
 99:         aes.GenerateIV();
100: 
101:         using var encryptor = aes.CreateEncryptor();
102:         using var ms = new MemoryStream();
103:         ms.Write(aes.IV, 0, aes.IV.Length);
104:         using (var cs = new CryptoStream(ms, encryptor, CryptoStreamMode.Write))
105:         using (var sw = new StreamWriter(cs))
106:         {
107:             sw.Write(text);
108:         }
109:         return Convert.ToBase64String(ms.ToArray());
110:     }
111: 
112:     private string DecryptString(string cipherText, string key)
113:     {
114:         byte[] fullCipher = Convert.FromBase64String(cipherText);
115:         using var aes = Aes.Create();
116:         var keyBytes = System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.HashData(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(key));
117:         aes.Key = keyBytes;
118: 
119:         byte[] iv = new byte[aes.BlockSize / 8];
120:         Array.Copy(fullCipher, 0, iv, 0, iv.Length);
121:         aes.IV = iv;
122: 
123:         using var decryptor = aes.CreateDecryptor();
124:         using var ms = new MemoryStream(fullCipher, iv.Length, fullCipher.Length - iv.Length);
125:         using var cs = new CryptoStream(ms, decryptor, CryptoStreamMode.Read);
126:         using var sr = new StreamReader(cs);
127:         return sr.ReadToEnd();
128:     }
129: 
130:     public void AddProfile(VpnProfile profile)
131:     {
132:         var profiles = LoadProfiles();
133:         profiles.Add(profile);
134:         SaveProfiles(profiles);
135:     }

137:     public void UpdateProfile(VpnProfile updatedProfile)
138:     {
139:         var profiles = LoadProfiles();
140:         var index = profiles.FindIndex(p => p.Id == updatedProfile.Id);
141: 
142:         if (index >= 0)
143:         {
144:             profiles[index] = updatedProfile;
145:         }
146:         else
147:         {
148:             profiles.Add(updatedProfile);
149:         }
150: 
151:         SaveProfiles(profiles);
152:     }

154:     public void DeleteProfile(string id)
155:     {
156:         var profiles = LoadProfiles();
157:         var profileToRemove = profiles.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == id);
158:         if (profileToRemove != null)
159:         {
160:             profiles.Remove(profileToRemove);
161:             SaveProfiles(profiles);
162:         }
163:     }

 17:     {
 18:         if (!sshService.IsConnected) return new ServerResources(0, 0, 0, "N/A", "0.0", "0 Mbps", 0, 0, 0, 0);
 19: 
 20:         string cmdText = $@"
 21:             export LC_ALL=C
 22:             export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/sbin:/usr/sbin
 23:             CORE=""{coreType.ToLower()}""
 24: 
 25:             CPU=$(top -bn1 2>/dev/null | grep -i '%Cpu' | head -n 1 | awk '{{print $2+$4}}' | cut -d. -f1 | cut -d, -f1)
 26:             RAM=$(free -m | awk 'NR==2{{printf ""%.0f"", $3*100/$2}}')
 27:             DISK=$(df -h / | awk '$NF==""/""{{print $5}}' | tr -d '%')
 28:             
 29:             UP_SEC=$(cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null | awk -F. '{{print $1}}')
 30:             UPTIME=$(awk -v t=""${{UP_SEC:-0}}"" 'BEGIN {{printf ""%dd %dh %dm"", t/86400, (t%86400)/3600, (t%3600)/60}}')
 31:             
 32:             LOADAVG=$(cat /proc/loadavg 2>/dev/null | awk '{{print $1}}')
 33:             
 34:             IFACE=$(ip route 2>/dev/null | grep default | awk '{{print $5}}' | head -n1)
 35:             RX1=$(cat /sys/class/net/$IFACE/statistics/rx_bytes 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
 36:             TX1=$(cat /sys/class/net/$IFACE/statistics/tx_bytes 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
 37:             sleep 1
 38:             RX2=$(cat /sys/class/net/$IFACE/statistics/rx_bytes 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
 39:             TX2=$(cat /sys/class/net/$IFACE/statistics/tx_bytes 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
 40:             
 41:             RX_MBPS=$(awk -v r1=""$RX1"" -v r2=""$RX2"" 'BEGIN {{ printf ""%.2f"", (r2-r1)*8/1000000 }}')
 42:             TX_MBPS=$(awk -v t1=""$TX1"" -v t2=""$TX2"" 'BEGIN {{ printf ""%.2f"", (t2-t1)*8/1000000 }}')
 43:             
 44:             if [ ""$CORE"" = ""sing-box"" ]; then
 45:                 CORE_PROC=$(pgrep -f ""sing-box run"" -c || echo 0)
 46:                 ERR_TOTAL=$(journalctl -u sing-box --since ""10 minutes ago"" --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -ic ""error\|fatal\|rejected"")
 47:             elif [ ""$CORE"" = ""trusttunnel"" ]; then
 48:                 CORE_PROC=$(pgrep -f ""trusttunnel"" -c || echo 0)
 49:                 ERR_TOTAL=$(journalctl -u trusttunnel --since ""10 minutes ago"" --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -ic ""error\|fatal\|panic"")
 50:             else
 51:                 CORE_PROC=$(pgrep -f ""xray run"" -c || echo 0)
 52:                 ERR_ACC=$(tail -n 1000 /var/log/xray/access.log 2>/dev/null | grep -ic ""rejected"")
 53:                 ERR_ERR=$(tail -n 1000 /var/log/xray/error.log 2>/dev/null | grep -ic ""error\|fail\|rejected"")
 54:                 ERR_TOTAL=$((ERR_ACC + ERR_ERR))
 55:             fi
 56:             
 57:             TCP_CONN=$(ss -Htun state established 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
 58:             SYN_RECV=$(ss -Ht state syn-recv 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
 59: 
 60:             echo ""${{CPU:-0}}|${{RAM:-0}}|${{DISK:-0}}|${{UPTIME:-N/A}}|${{LOADAVG:-0}}|↓${{RX_MBPS}} ↑${{TX_MBPS}} Mbps|${{CORE_PROC:-0}}|${{TCP_CONN:-0}}|${{SYN_RECV:-0}}|${{ERR_TOTAL:-0}}""
 61:         ".Replace("\r", "");
 62: 
 63:         try
 64:         {
 65:             string result = await sshService.ExecuteCommandAsync(cmdText);
 66:             string[] parts = result.Replace("\r", "").Replace("\n", "").Trim().Split('|');
 67: 
 68:             if (parts.Length == 10)
 69:             {
 70:                 int.TryParse(parts[0], out int cpu);
 71:                 int.TryParse(parts[1], out int ram);
 72:                 int.TryParse(parts[2], out int ssd);
 73:                 int.TryParse(parts[6], out int coreProc);
 74:                 int.TryParse(parts[7], out int tcpConn);
 75:                 int.TryParse(parts[8], out int synRecv);
 76:                 int.TryParse(parts[9], out int errorRate);
 77: 
 78:                 return new ServerResources(cpu, ram, ssd, parts[3], parts[4], parts[5], coreProc, tcpConn, synRecv, errorRate);
 79:             }
 80:         }
 81:         catch { }
 82: 
 83:         return new ServerResources(0, 0, 0, "N/A", "0.0", "0 Mbps", 0, 0, 0, 0);
 84:     }

136:                     string connId = idMatch.Success ? idMatch.Groups[1].Value : "";

148:                             connIdToIp[connId] = ip.Replace("[", "").Replace("]", "");
149:                         }
150:                     }

154:                         if (ipMatch.Success)

157:                             ip = ip.Contains(":") && !ip.StartsWith("[") ? ip.Split(':')[0] : ip;

159:                         }

198:                     {

200:                         else if (parts[i].StartsWith("[") && parts[i].EndsWith("]")) user = parts[i].Trim('[', ']');
201:

203:                         {

206:                     }
207:

209:                     {

212:                     }
213:                 }
214:                 catch { }
215:             }
216:         }
217:

219:         string dbPath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "GeoLite2-Country.mmdb");
220:         if (!File.Exists(dbPath))
221:         {
222:             string fallbackPath = Path.Combine(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory(), "GeoLite2-Country.mmdb");
223:             if (File.Exists(fallbackPath))
224:             {
225:                 dbPath = fallbackPath;
226:             }
227:             else
228:             {

230:                 while (currentDir != null)

233:                     if (File.Exists(checkPath))

236:                         break;

239:                 }

241:         }

259:         else

312:     public async Task<(bool Success, long RoundtripTime)> PingServerAsync(string ip, int timeoutMs = 2000)
313:     {
314:         // 1. Стандартный ICMP Ping (Идеально работает до включения ключа)
315:         try
316:         {
317:             using var pinger = new Ping();
318:             var reply = await pinger.SendPingAsync(ip, timeoutMs);
319:             // Foolproof защита: реальный удаленный сервер не ответит быстрее 2 мс. 
320:             // Всё что быстрее — это фальшивый ответ от локального TUN-адаптера.
321:             if (reply.Status == IPStatus.Success && reply.RoundtripTime > 2)
322:             {
323:                 return (true, reply.RoundtripTime);
324:             }
325:         }
326:         catch { }
327: 
328:         // 2. Бронебойный TCP Payload Ping (Обходит Fake Handshake)
329:         // Мы отправляем минимальный HTTP-запрос на быстрые порты и ждем ответ.
330:         // Nginx (80), Python (8080) и Xray (443) обрабатывают это мгновенно (< 1 мс),
331:         // поэтому замеряется ИСКЛЮЧИТЕЛЬНО сетевое время (твои 40-70 ms).
332:         int[] fastPorts = { 80, 8080, 443 };
333: 
334:         foreach (var port in fastPorts)
335:         {
336:             var tcpClient = new System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient();
337:             try
338:             {
339:                 var sw = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
340:                 var connectTask = tcpClient.ConnectAsync(ip, port);
341: 
342:                 if (await Task.WhenAny(connectTask, Task.Delay(timeoutMs)) == connectTask)
343:                 {
344:                     await connectTask; // Убеждаемся, что нет исключений подключения
345: 
346:                     using var stream = tcpClient.GetStream();
347: 
348:                     // Отправляем легчайший HTTP HEAD запрос
349:                     byte[] request = System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes($"HEAD / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: {ip}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n");
350:                     await stream.WriteAsync(request, 0, request.Length);
351: 
352:                     // Ждем реакции сервера (ответ или разрыв соединения)
353:                     byte[] buffer = new byte[1];
354:                     var readTask = stream.ReadAsync(buffer, 0, 1);
355: 
356:                     if (await Task.WhenAny(readTask, Task.Delay(timeoutMs)) == readTask)
357:                     {
358:                         // Независимо от того, ответил сервер (bytes > 0) или сбросил соединение
359:                         // (bytes == 0, как делает Xray Reality на 443 порту при мусорном трафике),
360:                         // это 100% честный сетевой Roundtrip.
361:                         sw.Stop();
362:                         long ping = sw.ElapsedMilliseconds;
363: 
364:                         // Защита от фальшивых локальных ответов
365:                         if (ping > 2)
366:                         {
367:                             return (true, ping);
368:                         }
369:                     }
370:                 }
371:             }
372:             catch { }
373:             finally
374:             {
375:                 // Жесткое закрытие сокета для предотвращения утечек в ОС
376:                 try { tcpClient.Close(); } catch { }
377:             }
378:         }
379: 
380:         return (false, 0);
381:     }
382: 
383:     /// <summary>
384:     /// метод выполняет комплексную проверку статуса ядра (Xray/Sing-Box/TrustTunnel) через SSH, собирая данные о версии, валидности конфига, аптайме и последних ошибках. Вся логика обработки и вычислений вынесена в единый shell-скрипт для минимизации количества SSH вызовов и обеспечения максимальной точности данных, особенно в условиях LXC/OpenVZ, где системные часы могут быть рассинхронизированы. Результат возвращается в виде объекта CoreStatusInfo, который может быть легко отображен в UI или сохранен в аналитике.
385:     /// </summary>
386:     /// <param name="sshService"></param>
387:     /// <param name="coreType"></param>
388:     /// <returns></returns>
389:     public async Task<CoreStatusInfo> GetCoreStatusInfoAsync(ISshService sshService, string coreType)
390:     {
391:         var info = new CoreStatusInfo();
392:         if (!sshService.IsConnected) return info;
393: 
394:         // ВНЕДРЕНО: Аптайм и статус конфига удалены (срезаны под корень).
395:         // Скрипт теперь максимально легкий и запрашивает только Версию и Ошибки логов.
396:         string cmdText = $@"
397:         export LC_ALL=C
398:         export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/sbin:/usr/sbin
399:         
400:         CORE=""{coreType.ToLower()}""
401:         SVC=$CORE
402:         BIN=$(command -v $CORE 2>/dev/null || echo ""/usr/local/bin/$CORE"")
403: 
404:         if [ ""$CORE"" = ""sing-box"" ]; then
405:             V=$($BIN version 2>/dev/null | grep 'version' | awk '{{print $3}}')
406:             E=$(journalctl -u $SVC -n 10 --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'error|fatal|panic|rejected' | tail -n 1 | sed 's/.*msg=//' | tr -d '\r\n|')
407:         elif [ ""$CORE"" = ""trusttunnel"" ]; then
408:             V=$($BIN --version 2>/dev/null | awk '{{print $2}}')
409:             E=$(journalctl -u $SVC -n 10 --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'error|fatal|panic' | tail -n 1 | tr -d '\r\n|')
410:         else
411:             V=$($BIN version 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | awk '{{print $2}}')
412:             if [ -z ""$V"" ]; then V=$($BIN -version 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | awk '{{print $2}}'); fi
413:             E=$(journalctl -u $SVC -n 10 --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'error|fail|rejected' | grep -v '\[Info\]' | tail -n 1 | tr -d '\r\n|')
414:         fi
415: 
416:         echo ""${{V:-Неизвестно}}|${{E:-Нет ошибок}}""
417:         ".Replace("\r", "");
418: 
419:         try
420:         {
421:             string result = await sshService.ExecuteCommandAsync(cmdText);
422: 
423:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result))
424:             {
425:                 info.LastError = "Таймаут SSH";
426:                 return info;
427:             }
428: 
429:             var parts = result.Replace("\r", "").Split('\n').LastOrDefault(s => s.Contains('|'))?.Split('|');
430: 
431:             if (parts != null && parts.Length >= 2)
432:             {
433:                 info.Version = parts[0].Trim();
434:                 string err = parts[1].Trim();
435:                 info.LastError = err.Length > 35 ? err.Substring(0, 35) + "..." : err;
436:             }
437:         }
438:         catch (Exception ex)
439:         {
440:             info.LastError = "КРАШ C#: " + ex.Message;
441:         }
442: 
443:         return info;
444:     }
445: }

 17:     private async Task RebuildInboundsAsync(JsonNode root, string serverIp)
 18:     {
 19:         var dbUsers = await _dbContext.Clients.Where(c => c.ServerIp == serverIp).ToListAsync();
 20:         var inbounds = root?["inbounds"]?.AsArray();
 21:         if (inbounds == null) return;
 22: 
 23:         var profile = _profileRepository.LoadProfiles().FirstOrDefault(p => p.IpAddress == serverIp);
 24:         string displayServer = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(profile?.ConnectionNode) ? profile.ConnectionNode.Trim() : serverIp;
 25: 
 26:         foreach (var inbound in inbounds.OfType<JsonObject>().ToList())
 27:         {
 28:             var type = inbound["type"]?.ToString();
 29:             var inboundDb = profile?.Inbounds.FirstOrDefault(i => i.Tag == inbound["tag"]?.ToString() || (i.Protocol == type && i.Port.ToString() == inbound["listen_port"]?.ToString()));
 30:             var settingsDb = inboundDb != null ? JsonNode.Parse(inboundDb.SettingsJson) : null;
 31: 
 32:             if (type == "vless")
 33:             {
 34:                 var isQuic = "quic".Equals(inbound["transport"]?["type"]?.ToString(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
 35:                              "xhttp".Equals(inbound["transport"]?["type"]?.ToString(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
 36: 
 37:                 // Синхронизация Reality ключей из БД в конфиг
 38:                 if (settingsDb != null && inbound["tls"]?["reality"] != null)
 39:                 {
 40:                     inbound["tls"]!["reality"]!["private_key"] = settingsDb["privateKey"]?.ToString();
 41:                     inbound["tls"]!["reality"]!["short_id"] = new JsonArray { settingsDb["shortId"]?.ToString() };
 42:                     inbound["tls"]!["server_name"] = settingsDb["sni"]?.ToString() ?? "google.com";
 43:                     inbound["tls"]!["reality"]!["handshake"]!["server"] = settingsDb["sni"]?.ToString() ?? "google.com";
 44:                 }
 45: 
 46:                 var targetUsers = dbUsers.Where(u => u.IsActive && ((!isQuic && u.IsVlessEnabled) || (isQuic && u.IsTrustTunnelEnabled))).ToList();
 47:                 var usersArray = new JsonArray();
 48: 
 49:                 if (targetUsers.Any())
 50:                 {
 51:                     foreach (var u in targetUsers)
 52:                         usersArray.Add(isQuic ? new JsonObject { ["name"] = u.Email, ["uuid"] = u.Uuid } : new JsonObject { ["name"] = u.Email, ["uuid"] = u.Uuid, ["flow"] = "xtls-rprx-vision" });
 53:                 }
 54:                 else usersArray.Add(new JsonObject { ["name"] = "init", ["uuid"] = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" });
 55: 
 56:                 inbound["users"] = usersArray;
 57:                 UpdateVlessLinks(inbound, dbUsers, displayServer, serverIp, isQuic);
 58:             }
 59:             else if (type == "hysteria2")
 60:             {
 61:                 // Синхронизация Obfs пароля из БД в конфиг
 62:                 if (settingsDb != null && inbound["obfs"] != null)
 63:                 {
 64:                     inbound["obfs"]!["password"] = settingsDb["obfsPassword"]?.ToString();
 65:                     inbound["tls"]!["server_name"] = settingsDb["sni"]?.ToString() ?? "bing.com";
 66:                 }
 67: 
 68:                 var targetUsers = dbUsers.Where(u => u.IsActive && u.IsHysteria2Enabled).ToList();
 69:                 var usersArray = new JsonArray();
 70:                 if (targetUsers.Any())
 71:                 {
 72:                     foreach (var u in targetUsers) usersArray.Add(new JsonObject { ["name"] = u.Email, ["password"] = u.Uuid });
 73:                 }
 74:                 else usersArray.Add(new JsonObject { ["name"] = "init", ["password"] = "init_pass" });
 75: 
 76:                 inbound["users"] = usersArray;
 77:                 UpdateHysteria2Links(inbound, dbUsers, displayServer);
 78:             }
 79:             else if (type == "trojan")
 80:             {
 81:                 // Синхронизация SNI из БД в конфиг
 82:                 if (settingsDb != null && inbound["tls"] != null)
 83:                 {
 84:                     inbound["tls"]!["server_name"] = settingsDb["sni"]?.ToString() ?? "bing.com";
 85:                 }
 86: 
 87:                 var targetUsers = dbUsers.Where(u => u.IsActive && u.IsTrojanEnabled).ToList();
 88:                 var usersArray = new JsonArray();
 89:                 if (targetUsers.Any())
 90:                 {
 91:                     foreach (var u in targetUsers) usersArray.Add(new JsonObject { ["password"] = u.Uuid, ["name"] = u.Email });
 92:                 }
 93:                 else usersArray.Add(new JsonObject { ["password"] = "init_pass", ["name"] = "init" });
 94: 
 95:                 inbound["users"] = usersArray;
 96:                 UpdateTrojanLinks(inbound, dbUsers, displayServer);
 97:             }
 98:             else if (type == "shadowsocks")
 99:             {
100:                 // Синхронизация метода из БД в конфиг
101:                 if (settingsDb != null)
102:                 {
103:                     inbound["method"] = settingsDb["method"]?.ToString() ?? "aes-256-gcm";
104:                 }
105: 
106:                 var targetUsers = dbUsers.Where(u => u.IsActive && u.IsShadowsocksEnabled).ToList();

123:     private void UpdateTrojanLinks(JsonObject inbound, List<VpnClient> dbUsers, string displayServer)
124:     {
125:         string safeIp = displayServer.Contains(":") && !displayServer.StartsWith("[") ? $"[{displayServer}]" : displayServer;
126:         int port = 4434;
127:         if (inbound["listen_port"] != null) int.TryParse(inbound["listen_port"]!.ToString(), out port);
128:         string sni = inbound["tls"]?["server_name"]?.ToString() ?? "bing.com";
129: 
130:         foreach (var u in dbUsers)
131:         {
132:             string encodedName = Uri.EscapeDataString($"KoFF_{u.Email}");
133:             u.TrojanLink = $"trojan://{u.Uuid}@{safeIp}:{port}?security=tls&sni={sni}&type=tcp&alpn=h2&allowInsecure=1&insecure=1#{encodedName}";
134:         }
135:     }

137:     private void UpdateShadowsocksLinks(JsonObject inbound, List<VpnClient> dbUsers, string displayServer)
138:     {
139:         string safeIp = displayServer.Contains(":") && !displayServer.StartsWith("[") ? $"[{displayServer}]" : displayServer;
140:         int port = 8388;
141:         if (inbound["listen_port"] != null) int.TryParse(inbound["listen_port"]!.ToString(), out port);
142:         string method = inbound["method"]?.ToString() ?? "aes-256-gcm";
143: 
144:         foreach (var u in dbUsers)
145:         {
146:             string credentials = $"{method}:{u.Uuid}";
147:             
148:             // ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Формат ss://base64(method:password)@host:port#name
149:             string base64Creds = Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(credentials));
150:             string encodedName = Uri.EscapeDataString($"KoFF_{u.Email}");
151:             
152:             u.ShadowsocksLink = $"ss://{base64Creds}@{safeIp}:{port}#{encodedName}";
153:         }
