 13: public partial class CabinetViewModel
 14: {
 15:     [ObservableProperty]
 16:     private string _coreTitleLabel = "Ядро (Ожидание)";
 17:     private long _previousTotalServerBytes = 0;
 18: 
 19:     // Добавляем переменную класса для отслеживания актуальной задачи
 20:     private Guid _activeMonitoringTaskId;
 21: 
 22:     private async Task StartMonitoringLoopAsync(VpnProfile profile, CancellationToken token)
 23:     {
 24:         // Захват локального ID задачи для защиты от гонки потоков (Race Condition)
 25:         var currentTaskId = Guid.NewGuid();
 26:         _activeMonitoringTaskId = currentTaskId;
 27: 
 28:         System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() => IsMonitoringActive = true);
 29: 
 30:         while (!token.IsCancellationRequested)
 31:         {
 32:             UpdateStatusSecurely("Подключение...", currentTaskId);
 33:             ISshService localSsh = _sshServiceFactory();
 34:             _currentMonitoringSsh = localSsh;
 35: 
 36:             string ip = profile.IpAddress ?? "";
 37:             string user = profile.Username ?? "root";
 38:             string pass = profile.Password ?? "";
 39:             string key = profile.KeyPath ?? "";
 40: 
 41:             _logger.Log("MONITORING", $"[START] Запуск цикла мониторинга. Ожидаемое Ядро: {profile.CoreType?.ToUpper()}");
 42: 
 43:             // ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Добавлен жесткий таймаут коннекта на уровне Task, чтобы исключить зависание UI
 44:             var connectTask = localSsh.ConnectAsync(ip, profile.Port, user, pass, key);
 45:             var timeoutTask = Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15), token);
 46: 
 47:             if (await Task.WhenAny(connectTask, timeoutTask) == timeoutTask || await connectTask != "SUCCESS")
 48:             {
 49:                 UpdateStatusSecurely("Ошибка соединения. Переподключение через 5с...", currentTaskId);
 50:                 if (_currentMonitoringSsh == localSsh) _currentMonitoringSsh = null;
 51:                 localSsh.Disconnect();
 52: 
 53:                 try { await Task.Delay(5000, token); continue; }
 54:                 catch (TaskCanceledException) { break; }
 55:             }
 56: 
 57:             UpdateStatusSecurely("Онлайн (Загрузка пользователей)", currentTaskId);
 58:             await LoadUsersAsync();
 59:             _ = _analyticsService.CleanupOldLogsAsync();
 60: 
 61:             try
 62:             {
 63:                 while (!token.IsCancellationRequested)
 64:                 {
 65:                     if (!localSsh.IsConnected) throw new Exception("SSH сокет закрыт сервером");
 66: 
 67:                     await RunMonitoringCycleStepAsync(localSsh, profile, token);
 68: 
 69:                     // FOOLPROOF: Динамическое обновление статуса каждую итерацию. 
 70:                     // Если цикл работает, пользователь всегда видит свежее время обновления.
 71:                     UpdateStatusSecurely($"Онлайн (Синхр: {DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss})", currentTaskId);
 72: 
 73:                     await Task.Delay(5000, token);
 74:                 }
 75:             }
 76:             catch (TaskCanceledException) { }
 77:             catch (Exception ex)
 78:             {
 79:                 UpdateStatusSecurely($"Связь потеряна. Реконнект...", currentTaskId);
 80:                 _logger.Log("MONITORING", $"Сбой: {ex.Message}");
 81:             }
 82:             finally
 83:             {
 84:                 localSsh.Disconnect();
 85:                 if (_currentMonitoringSsh == localSsh) { _currentMonitoringSsh = null; }
 86:             }
 87: 
 88:             if (token.IsCancellationRequested) break;
 89: 
 90:             try { await Task.Delay(3000, token); }
 91:             catch (TaskCanceledException) { break; }
 92:         }
 93: 
 94:         UpdateStatusSecurely("Оффлайн", currentTaskId);
 95:         System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() => IsMonitoringActive = false);
 96:     }
 97: 
 98:     // ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Безопасное обновление UI, отклоняющее команды от убитых/старых потоков
 99:     private void UpdateStatusSecurely(string status, Guid taskId)
100:     {
101:         System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
102:         {
103:             if (_activeMonitoringTaskId == taskId)
104:             {
105:                 ServerStatus = status;
106:             }
107:         });
108:     }
109: 
110:     private async Task RunMonitoringCycleStepAsync(ISshService localSsh, VpnProfile profile, CancellationToken token)
111:     {
112:         string ip = profile.IpAddress ?? "";
113: 
114:         // ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Определяем ядро динамически на каждом шаге цикла, 
115:         // чтобы изменения из БД (если они произошли) применялись мгновенно.
116:         bool isSingBox = profile.CoreType == "sing-box";
117:         bool isTrustTunnel = profile.CoreType == "trusttunnel";
118: 
119:         string displayCoreName = isSingBox ? "Sing-box" : (isTrustTunnel ? "TrustTunnel" : "Xray-core");
120:         if (profile.Inbounds.Any(i => i.Protocol.ToLower() == "trusttunnel") && !isTrustTunnel)
121:         {
122:             displayCoreName += " + TrustTunnel";
123:         }
124: 
125:         string serviceName = isSingBox ? "sing-box" : (isTrustTunnel ? "trusttunnel" : "xray");
126: 
127:         var pingResult = await _monitorService.PingServerAsync(ip);
128:         PingMs = pingResult.Success ? pingResult.RoundtripTime : 0;
129: 
130:         var res = await _monitorService.GetResourcesAsync(localSsh, profile.CoreType);
131:         NetworkSpeed = res.NetworkSpeed; XrayProcesses = res.XrayProcesses; SynRecv = res.SynRecv; ErrorRate = res.ErrorRate;
132: 
133:         await UpdateSystemMetricsAsync(localSsh, res);
134: 
135:         int tcpCount = await GetTcpConnectionsCountAsync(localSsh, res.TcpConnections);
136:         TcpConnections = tcpCount;
137: 
138:         string fallback = await localSsh.ExecuteCommandAsync("systemctl is-active sing-box xray trusttunnel 2>/dev/null");
139: 
140:         bool sbActive = false, xrActive = false, ttActive = false;
141: 
142:         // ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Парсим статусы ТОЛЬКО если сервер реально ответил.
143:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fallback))
144:         {
145:             var fbLines = fallback.Split('\n', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
146:             sbActive = fbLines.Length > 0 && fbLines[0].Trim() == "active";
147:             xrActive = fbLines.Length > 1 && fbLines[1].Trim() == "active";
148:             ttActive = fbLines.Length > 2 && fbLines[2].Trim() == "active";
149:         }
150: 
151:         string actualDisplayCore = displayCoreName;
152:         if (sbActive && xrActive) actualDisplayCore = "Sing-box + Xray";
153:         else if (sbActive) actualDisplayCore = "Sing-box";
154:         else if (xrActive) actualDisplayCore = "Xray-core";
155: 
156:         if (ttActive && !actualDisplayCore.Contains("TrustTunnel", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
157:             actualDisplayCore = string.Equals(actualDisplayCore, "TrustTunnel", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "TrustTunnel" : actualDisplayCore + " + TrustTunnel";
158: 
159:         string coreStatusStr = "Stopped";
160:         if (actualDisplayCore.Contains("Sing-box", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && sbActive) coreStatusStr = "Active";
161:         else if (actualDisplayCore.Contains("Xray", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && xrActive) coreStatusStr = "Active";
162:         else if (actualDisplayCore.Contains("TrustTunnel", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && ttActive) coreStatusStr = "Active";
163: 
164:         string journalLogs = await localSsh.ExecuteCommandAsync($"journalctl -u {serviceName} -n 5 --no-pager");
165:         string accessLogs = await GetAccessLogsAsync(localSsh, isSingBox, isTrustTunnel);
166:         string grepTest = await GetParserTestLogsAsync(localSsh, isSingBox, isTrustTunnel);
167: 
168:         var coreStats = await _monitorService.GetCoreStatusInfoAsync(localSsh, profile.CoreType);
169:         var allOnlineStats = await _monitorService.GetUserOnlineStatsAsync(localSsh, profile.CoreType);
170: 
171:         var activeUsernames = await GetActiveUsernamesAsync(localSsh, isSingBox, isTrustTunnel);
172:         var violationsBatch = await ProcessViolationsAsync(localSsh, isSingBox, isTrustTunnel, activeUsernames);
173: 
174:         var trafficStats = await CalculateTrafficStatsAsync(localSsh, isSingBox, isTrustTunnel, activeUsernames);
175: 
176:         var trafficBatch = new Dictionary<string, long>();
177:         var connectionBatch = new List<(string Email, string Ip, string Country)>();
178: 
179:         bool dbNeedsUpdate = false;
180: 
181:         // ИЗМЕНЕНО: InvokeAsync позволяет нам безопасно обращаться к БД из UI-потока
182:         await System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(async () =>
183:         {
184:             UpdateUiAfterCycle(actualDisplayCore, coreStatusStr, coreStats, journalLogs, accessLogs, grepTest);
185: 
186:             if (SelectedServer != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fallback))
187:             {
188:                 string detectedCoreType = SelectedServer.CoreType;
189:                 if (sbActive) detectedCoreType = "sing-box";
190:                 else if (xrActive) detectedCoreType = "xray";
191:                 else if (ttActive) detectedCoreType = "trusttunnel";
192: 
193:                 if (SelectedServer.CoreType != detectedCoreType && (sbActive || xrActive || ttActive))
194:                 {
195:                     _logger.Log("MONITORING", $"[FOOLPROOF] Обнаружено расхождение ядра! БД: {SelectedServer.CoreType}, Реал: {detectedCoreType}. Обновляем...");
196:                     SelectedServer.CoreType = detectedCoreType;
197:                     _profileRepository.UpdateProfile(SelectedServer);
198:                 }
199:             }
200: 
201:             // Вызов нашего нового умного метода
202:             dbNeedsUpdate = await ProcessClientsAfterCycleAsync(trafficStats, activeUsernames, allOnlineStats, trafficBatch, connectionBatch);
203: 
204:             if (dbNeedsUpdate && SelectedServer != null)
205:             {
206:                 if (isSingBox) _ = _singBoxUserManager.SaveTrafficToDbAsync(ip, Clients);
207:                 else if (isTrustTunnel) _ = _trustTunnelUserManager.SaveTrafficToDbAsync(ip, Clients);
208:                 else _ = _userManager.SaveTrafficToDbAsync(ip, Clients);
209:             }
210: 
211:             TotalUsers = Clients.Count;
212:             ActiveUsers = Clients.Count(c => c.ActiveConnections > 0);
213:             TotalTraffic = FormatBytes(Clients.Sum(c => c.TrafficUsed));
214:         });
215: 
216:         _ = _analyticsService.SaveBatchAsync(ip, trafficBatch, connectionBatch, violationsBatch);
217:     }

  1: using KoFFPanel.Application.Interfaces;
  2: using KoFFPanel.Domain.Entities;
  3: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
  4: using System;
  5: using System.Collections.Generic;
  6: using System.Linq;
  7: using System.Threading.Tasks;
  8: using System.IO;
  9: 
 10: namespace KoFFPanel.Presentation.Features.Cabinet;
 11: 
 12: public partial class CabinetViewModel
 13: {
 14:     private async Task UpdateSystemMetricsAsync(ISshService localSsh, ServerResources res)
 15:     {
 16:         try
 17:         {
 18:             string bashCmd = "cpu=$(top -bn1 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'Cpu\\(s\\)' | awk '{print $2+$4}' | cut -d. -f1 | tr -d '\n'); " +
 19:                              "if [ -z \"$cpu\" ]; then cpu=$(vmstat 1 2 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{print 100 - $15}'); fi; " +
 20:                              "ram=$(free | awk '/Mem:/ {printf(\"%d\", $3/$2 * 100)}' 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n'); " +
 21:                              "ssd=$(df / | awk 'NR==2 {print $5}' | sed 's/%//' 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n'); " +
 22:                              "load=$(cat /proc/loadavg 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | tr -d '\n'); " +
 23:                              "up=$(uptime -p 2>/dev/null | sed 's/up //'); " +
 24:                              "echo \"${cpu:-0}|${ram:-0}|${ssd:-0}|${load:-0.0}|${up:-N/A}\"";
 25: 
 26:             string sysCmd = await localSsh.ExecuteCommandAsync(bashCmd);
 27:             var parts = sysCmd.Trim().Split('|');
 28: 
 29:             if (parts.Length >= 5)
 30:             {
 31:                 if (double.TryParse(parts[0].Replace(',', '.'), System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Any, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double c)) CpuUsage = (int)c;
 32:                 if (int.TryParse(parts[1], out int r)) RamUsage = r;
 33:                 if (int.TryParse(parts[2], out int s)) SsdUsage = s;
 34:                 if (double.TryParse(parts[3].Replace(',', '.'), System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Any, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double l)) LoadAverage = l.ToString("0.00", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
 35:                 Uptime = FormatUptime(parts[4]);
 36:             }
 37:             else { SetFallbackMetrics(res); }
 38:         }
 39:         catch { SetFallbackMetrics(res); }
 40:     }
 41: 
 42:     private string FormatUptime(string rawUp)
 43:     {
 44:         rawUp = rawUp.Replace(" weeks", "w").Replace(" week", "w").Replace(" days", "d").Replace(" day", "d").Replace(" hours", "h").Replace(" hour", "h").Replace(" minutes", "m").Replace(" minute", "m").Replace(",", "");
 45:         var upParts = rawUp.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
 46:         return upParts.Length > 2 ? $"{upParts[0]} {upParts[1]}\n{string.Join(" ", upParts.Skip(2))}" : rawUp;
 47:     }

 50:     {
 51:         CpuUsage = res.Cpu; RamUsage = res.Ram; SsdUsage = res.Ssd; Uptime = res.Uptime; LoadAverage = res.LoadAvg;
 52:     }

 82:     private async Task<HashSet<string>> GetActiveUsernamesAsync(ISshService localSsh, bool isSingBox, bool isTrustTunnel)
 83:     {
 84:         string cmd = isSingBox ? "tail -n 100 /var/log/sing-box/access.log 2>/dev/null | grep 'inbound connection'" :
 85:                      isTrustTunnel ? "journalctl -u trusttunnel --since \"1 min ago\" --no-pager" :
 86:                      "tail -n 200 /var/log/xray/access.log 2>/dev/null | grep 'accepted'";
 87: 
 88:         string recentLogs = await localSsh.ExecuteCommandAsync(cmd);
 89:         var activeUsernames = new HashSet<string>();
 90: 
 91:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(recentLogs))
 92:         {
 93:             var lines = recentLogs.Split(new[] { '\n', '\r' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
 94:             foreach (var line in lines)
 95:             {
 96:                 if (isSingBox) ProcessSingBoxLine(line, activeUsernames);
 97:                 else ProcessXrayLine(line, activeUsernames);
 98:             }
 99:         }
100:         return activeUsernames;

103:     private void ProcessSingBoxLine(string line, HashSet<string> activeUsernames)
104:     {
105:         int inboundIdx = line.IndexOf("inbound connection");
106:         if (inboundIdx != -1)
107:         {
108:             string prefix = line.Substring(0, inboundIdx);
109:             int lastBracketClose = prefix.LastIndexOf(']');
110:             if (lastBracketClose != -1)
111:             {
112:                 int lastBracketOpen = prefix.LastIndexOf('[', lastBracketClose);
113:                 if (lastBracketOpen != -1)
114:                 {
115:                     string potentialUser = prefix.Substring(lastBracketOpen + 1, lastBracketClose - lastBracketOpen - 1).Trim();
116:                     if (Clients.Any(c => c.Email == potentialUser)) activeUsernames.Add(potentialUser);
117:                 }
118:             }
119:         }
120:     }

122:     private void ProcessXrayLine(string line, HashSet<string> activeUsernames)
123:     {
124:         var logParts = line.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
125:         foreach (var part in logParts)
126:         {
127:             if (part.StartsWith("email:")) activeUsernames.Add(part.Replace("email:", "").Trim());
128:             else if (part.StartsWith("[") && part.EndsWith("]"))
129:             {
130:                 string potentialUser = part.Trim('[', ']');
131:                 if (Clients.Any(c => c.Email == potentialUser)) activeUsernames.Add(potentialUser);
132:             }
133:         }
134:     }

136:     private async Task<List<(string Email, string ViolationType)>> ProcessViolationsAsync(ISshService localSsh, bool isSingBox, bool isTrustTunnel, HashSet<string> activeUsernames)
137:     {
138:         List<string> torrentDomains = await LoadTorrentDomainsAsync();
139:         string rawViolationLogs = isSingBox ? await localSsh.ExecuteCommandAsync("journalctl -u sing-box --since \"1 min ago\" --no-pager | grep -iE 'inbound connection|sniffed'") :
140:                                  isTrustTunnel ? "" :
141:                                  await localSsh.ExecuteCommandAsync("tail -n 200 /var/log/xray/access.log 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'accepted|rejected|torrent-logger'");
142: 
143:         var violationsBatch = new List<(string Email, string ViolationType)>();
144:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawViolationLogs)) return violationsBatch;
145: 
146:         var vlines = rawViolationLogs.Split(new[] { '\n', '\r' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
147:         if (isSingBox) ProcessSingBoxViolations(vlines, torrentDomains, violationsBatch);
148:         else ProcessXrayViolations(vlines, torrentDomains, violationsBatch);
149: 
150:         return violationsBatch.Distinct().ToList();
151:     }

153:     private async Task<List<string>> LoadTorrentDomainsAsync()
154:     {
155:         string rulesFile = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "rules", "torrent_domains.txt");
156:         if (File.Exists(rulesFile))
157:         {
158:             var ruleLines = await File.ReadAllLinesAsync(rulesFile);
159:             return ruleLines.Where(l => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(l)).Select(l => l.Trim().ToLower()).ToList();
160:         }
161:         return new List<string> { "torrent", "tracker", "rutracker", "nnmclub", "kinozal", "rutor", "piratebay" };
162:     }
163: 
164:     private void ProcessSingBoxViolations(string[] lines, List<string> torrentDomains, List<(string, string)> batch)
165:     {
166:         var connDict = new Dictionary<string, (string User, string Domain)>();
167:         foreach (var line in lines)
168:         {
169:             int idStart = line.IndexOf(" [");
170:             if (idStart == -1) continue;
171:             int idEnd = line.IndexOf(' ', idStart + 2);
172:             if (idEnd == -1) continue;
173:             string id = line.Substring(idStart + 2, idEnd - idStart - 2);
174:             if (!connDict.ContainsKey(id)) connDict[id] = ("Unknown", "Unknown");
175:             var info = connDict[id];
176: 
177:             if (line.Contains("inbound connection"))
178:             {
179:                 int uStart = line.IndexOf("]: [");
180:                 if (uStart != -1) { int uEnd = line.IndexOf("] inbound", uStart); if (uEnd != -1) info.User = line.Substring(uStart + 4, uEnd - uStart - 4); }
181:                 int toIdx = line.IndexOf("to ");
182:                 if (toIdx != -1) { string destIp = line.Substring(toIdx + 3).Replace("tcp:", "").Replace("udp:", "").Split(':')[0]; if (info.Domain == "Unknown") info.Domain = destIp; }
183:             }
184:             else if (line.Contains("sniffed") && line.Contains("domain: "))
185:             {
186:                 int dStart = line.IndexOf("domain: ");
187:                 if (dStart != -1) { string dom = line.Substring(dStart + 8).Split(',')[0].Trim(); if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dom)) info.Domain = dom; }
188:             }
189:             connDict[id] = info;
190:         }
191:         foreach (var kvp in connDict)
192:         {
193:             if (kvp.Value.User != "Unknown" && kvp.Value.Domain != "Unknown" && torrentDomains.Any(td => kvp.Value.Domain.ToLower().Contains(td)))
194:                 batch.Add((kvp.Value.User, $"Трекер / P2P: {kvp.Value.Domain}"));
195:         }
196:     }
197: 
198:     private void ProcessXrayViolations(string[] lines, List<string> torrentDomains, List<(string, string)> batch)
199:     {
200:         foreach (var line in lines)
201:         {
202:             string domain = "Unknown"; string violatorEmail = "";
203:             var logParts = line.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
204:             for (int i = 0; i < logParts.Length; i++)
205:             {
206:                 if ((logParts[i] == "accepted" || logParts[i] == "rejected" || logParts[i] == "[torrent-logger]") && i + 1 < logParts.Length)
207:                     domain = logParts[i + 1].Replace("tcp:", "").Replace("udp:", "").Split(':')[0];
208:                 if (logParts[i].StartsWith("email:")) violatorEmail = logParts[i].Replace("email:", "").Trim();
209:                 else if (logParts[i].StartsWith("[") && logParts[i].EndsWith("]")) { string pot = logParts[i].Trim('[', ']'); if (Clients.Any(c => c.Email == pot)) violatorEmail = pot; }
210:             }
211:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(violatorEmail) && domain != "Unknown" && torrentDomains.Any(td => domain.ToLower().Contains(td)))
212:                 batch.Add((violatorEmail, $"Трекер / P2P: {domain}"));
213:         }
214:     }

216:     private async Task<Dictionary<string, long>> CalculateTrafficStatsAsync(ISshService localSsh, bool isSingBox, bool isTrustTunnel, HashSet<string> activeUsernames)
217:     {
218:         Dictionary<string, long> trafficStats;
219: 
220:         if (!isSingBox && !isTrustTunnel)
221:         {
222:             trafficStats = await _userManager.GetTrafficStatsAsync(localSsh);
223:             foreach (var kvp in trafficStats)
224:             {
225:                 long prev = _previousTrafficStats.TryGetValue(kvp.Key, out long p) ? p : 0;
226:                 if (kvp.Value > prev) activeUsernames.Add(kvp.Key);
227:             }
228:             return trafficStats;
229:         }
230: 
231:         trafficStats = new Dictionary<string, long>();
232:         string netBytesCmd = "IFACE=$(ip route | grep default | awk '{print $5}' | head -n1); echo $(( $(cat /sys/class/net/$IFACE/statistics/rx_bytes 2>/dev/null || echo 0) + $(cat /sys/class/net/$IFACE/statistics/tx_bytes 2>/dev/null || echo 0) ))";
233: 
234:         string cmdResult = await localSsh.ExecuteCommandAsync(netBytesCmd);
235:         if (long.TryParse(cmdResult.Trim(), out long currentTotalServerBytes))
236:         {
237:             if (_previousTotalServerBytes > 0 && currentTotalServerBytes > _previousTotalServerBytes)
238:             {
239:                 long delta = currentTotalServerBytes - _previousTotalServerBytes;
240:                 var recentlyActive = Clients.Where(c => c.LastOnline.HasValue && (DateTime.Now - c.LastOnline.Value).TotalMinutes <= 3).Select(c => c.Email ?? "").ToList();
241:                 foreach (var u in activeUsernames) if (!recentlyActive.Contains(u)) recentlyActive.Add(u);
242: 
243:                 if (recentlyActive.Count > 0 && delta > 10240)
244:                 {
245:                     long bytesPerUser = delta / recentlyActive.Count;
246:                     foreach (var uname in recentlyActive)
247:                     {
248:                         trafficStats[uname] = (_previousTrafficStats.TryGetValue(uname, out long p) ? p : 0) + bytesPerUser;
249:                         activeUsernames.Add(uname);
250:                     }
251:                 }
252:             }
253:             _previousTotalServerBytes = currentTotalServerBytes;
254:         }
255:         return trafficStats;
256:     }

261:         XrayStatus = coreStatusStr; XrayVersion = coreStats.Version; XrayConfigStatus = coreStats.ConfigStatus;

264:     }

266:     // ИЗМЕНЕНИЕ: Метод стал асинхронным (Task<bool>), чтобы дождаться ответа от БД Антифрода
267:     private async Task<bool> ProcessClientsAfterCycleAsync(Dictionary<string, long> trafficStats, HashSet<string> activeUsernames, List<UserOnlineInfo> allOnlineStats, Dictionary<string, long> trafficBatch, List<(string, string, string)> connectionBatch)
268:     {
269:         bool dbNeedsUpdate = false;
270:         if (DateTime.Today != _currentDay) { _dailyIps.Clear(); _currentDay = DateTime.Today; }
271: 
272:         // Достаем наш новый сервис напрямую из провайдера
273:         var antiFraudService = _serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAntiFraudService>();
274: 
275:         foreach (var client in Clients)
276:         {
277:             string email = client.Email ?? "Unknown";
278:             string currentIp = "";
279: 
280:             if (trafficStats.TryGetValue(email, out long currentBytes))
281:             {
282:                 long prev = _previousTrafficStats.TryGetValue(email, out long p) ? p : 0;
283:                 long delta = currentBytes >= prev ? currentBytes - prev : currentBytes;
284:                 if (delta > 0) { client.TrafficUsed += delta; dbNeedsUpdate = true; trafficBatch[email] = delta; }
285:                 _previousTrafficStats[email] = currentBytes;
286:             }
287: 
288:             if (activeUsernames.Contains(email))
289:             {
290:                 var log = allOnlineStats.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Email == email);
291:                 client.ActiveConnections = log != null && log.ActiveSessions > 0 ? log.ActiveSessions : 1;
292:                 client.LastOnline = DateTime.Now;
293: 
294:                 if (log != null)
295:                 {
296:                     client.LastIp = log.LastIp;
297:                     currentIp = log.LastIp ?? "";
298:                     if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(log.Country)) client.Country = log.Country;
299:                     connectionBatch.Add((email, log.LastIp ?? "", client.Country ?? ""));
300:                 }
301:             }
302:             else
303:             {
304:                 client.ActiveConnections = (client.LastOnline.HasValue && (DateTime.Now - client.LastOnline.Value).TotalMinutes <= 3) ? 1 : 0;
305:             }
306: 
307:             // Передаем собранные данные в умный алгоритм
308:             long trafficDelta = trafficStats.TryGetValue(email, out long d) ? d : 0;
309:             if (await CheckAntiFraudAndLimitsAsync(client, trafficDelta, currentIp, antiFraudService)) dbNeedsUpdate = true;
310:         }
311:         return dbNeedsUpdate;
312:     }
313: 
314:     private async Task<bool> CheckAntiFraudAndLimitsAsync(VpnClient client, long delta, string currentIp, IAntiFraudService antiFraudService)
315:     {
316:         if (!client.IsActive) return false;
317: 
318:         // Лимиты трафика и срок действия остаются с авто-баном (это биллинг)
319:         bool isExceeded = client.TrafficLimit > 0 && client.TrafficUsed >= client.TrafficLimit;
320:         bool isExpired = client.ExpiryDate.HasValue && client.ExpiryDate.Value.Date <= DateTime.Now.Date;
321:         if (isExceeded || isExpired)
322:         {
323:             client.IsActive = false;
324:             _ = BlockUserAsync(client, isExceeded ? "Превышен лимит" : "Истек срок");
325:             return true;
326:         }
327: 
328:         // АНТИФРОД: Теперь работает в режиме наблюдения (Observation Mode)
329:         if (client.IsAntiFraudEnabled && client.ActiveConnections > 0 && SelectedServer != null)
330:         {
331:             var (isFraud, reason) = await antiFraudService.EvaluateClientAsync(SelectedServer.IpAddress ?? "", client, currentIp, delta);
332: 
333:             // Автоматическая блокировка убрана. Мы только пишем причину в столбец Note.
334:             if (isFraud && client.Note != reason)
335:             {
336:                 client.Note = reason;
337:                 return true; // Возвращаем true, чтобы UI обновился и записал заметку в БД
338:             }
339:             else if (!isFraud && client.Note != null && client.Note.StartsWith("ФРОД"))
340:             {
341:                 // Очищаем заметку, если юзер перестал нарушать и его риск упал ниже 100%
342:                 client.Note = "";
343:                 return true;
344:             }
345:         }
346:         return false;
347:     }

349:     private async Task LoadUsersAsync()
350:     {
351:         var ssh = _currentMonitoringSsh; var server = SelectedServer;
352:         if (ssh == null || !ssh.IsConnected || server == null) return;
353:         string ip = server.IpAddress ?? "";
354:         var realUsers = server.CoreType == "sing-box" ? await _singBoxUserManager.GetUsersAsync(ssh, ip) :
355:                         (server.CoreType == "trusttunnel" ? await _trustTunnelUserManager.GetUsersAsync(ssh, ip) : await _userManager.GetUsersAsync(ssh, ip));
356:         System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() => { Clients.Clear(); foreach (var u in realUsers) Clients.Add(u); });
357:     }

359:     private async Task BlockUserAsync(VpnClient client, string reason)
360:     {
361:         var ssh = _currentMonitoringSsh; var server = SelectedServer;
362:         if (ssh == null || !ssh.IsConnected || server == null) return;
363:         string email = client.Email ?? "Unknown"; string ip = server.IpAddress ?? "";
364:         ServerStatus = $"Блокировка {email} ({reason})...";
365:         var (success, msg) = server.CoreType == "sing-box" ? await _singBoxUserManager.ToggleUserStatusAsync(ssh, ip, email, false) :
366:                             (server.CoreType == "trusttunnel" ? await _trustTunnelUserManager.ToggleUserStatusAsync(ssh, ip, email, false) : await _userManager.ToggleUserStatusAsync(ssh, ip, email, false));
367:         ServerStatus = success ? $"Онлайн ({email} заблокирован)" : $"Ошибка блокировки: {msg}";
368:     }

111:     { 
112:         if (SelectedServer == null) return; 
113:         var w = _serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<TerminalWindow>(); 
114:         if (System.Windows.Application.Current.MainWindow != null) w.Owner = System.Windows.Application.Current.MainWindow; 
115:         if (w.DataContext is TerminalViewModel vm) vm.Initialize(SelectedServer, command); 
116:         w.Show(); 
117:     }
118: 
119:     [RelayCommand]
120:     private async Task UpdateGeoDataAsync()
121:     {
122:         if (_currentMonitoringSsh == null || !_currentMonitoringSsh.IsConnected || SelectedServer == null) return;
123: 
124:         // ВНЕДРЕНО: Защита от дурака + try-catch обертка
125:         var result = System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
126:             "Запустить скачивание свежих баз GeoIP и GeoSite с GitHub?\nЭто может занять несколько секунд.",
127:             "Обновление баз", System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.YesNo, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Question);
128: 
129:         if (result != System.Windows.MessageBoxResult.Yes) return;
130: 
131:         try
132:         {
133:             ServerStatus = "Скачивание и обновление баз GeoSite...";
134:             var (success, msg) = await _xrayConfigurator.UpdateGeoDataAsync(_currentMonitoringSsh);
135: 
136:             if (success)
137:             {
138:                 ServerStatus = "Онлайн (Базы GeoSite успешно обновлены!)";
139: 
140:                 // Чтобы базы подхватились, нужно мягко перечитать конфиг
141:                 if (SelectedServer.CoreType == "sing-box")
142:                     await _currentMonitoringSsh.ExecuteCommandAsync("killall -HUP sing-box 2>/dev/null");
143:             }
144:             else
145:             {
146:                 ServerStatus = $"ОШИБКА: {msg}";
147:             }
148:         }
149:         catch (Exception ex)
150:         {
151:             ServerStatus = "КРАШ при обновлении баз";
152:             _logger.Log("GEO-ERROR", ex.Message);
153:         }
154:     }
155: 
156:     [RelayCommand]
157:     private void CopyXrayLogs()
158:     {
159:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(XrayLogs)) return;
160: 
161:         try
162:         {
163:             // ВНЕДРЕНО: 100% защита от ThreadStateException. 
164:             // Буфер обмена доступен ТОЛЬКО из главного UI-потока (STA).
165:             System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
166:             {
167:                 System.Windows.Clipboard.SetText(XrayLogs);
168:             });
169: 
170:             ServerStatus = "Логи скопированы в буфер обмена!";
171:         }
172:         catch (Exception ex)
173:         {
174:             _logger.Log("UI-ERROR", $"Ошибка копирования: {ex.Message}");
175:             ServerStatus = "Ошибка копирования логов";
176:         }
177:     }
178: 
179:     [RelayCommand]
180:     private async Task RestartXrayAsync()
181:     {
182:         var ssh = _currentMonitoringSsh;
183:         var server = SelectedServer;
184:         if (ssh == null || !ssh.IsConnected || server == null) return;
185: 
186:         // ВНЕДРЕНО: Защита от дурака (предотвращение случайного клика)
187:         var result = System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
188:             $"Вы уверены, что хотите жестко перезапустить ядро ({server.CoreType})?\nТекущие сессии пользователей будут кратковременно разорваны!",
189:             "Подтверждение рестарта", System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.YesNo, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
190: 
191:         if (result != System.Windows.MessageBoxResult.Yes) return;
192: 
193:         ServerStatus = $"Перезапуск {server.CoreType}...";
194:         try
195:         {
196:             string svc = server.CoreType.ToLower();
197:             string cmd = $"systemctl restart {svc}";
198: 
199:             // Умная логика: если TrustTunnel установлен параллельно, рестартуем и его
200:             if (server.Inbounds.Any(i => i.Protocol.ToLower() == "trusttunnel") && svc != "trusttunnel")
201:             {
202:                 cmd += " && systemctl restart trusttunnel";
203:             }
204: 
205:             await ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync(cmd);
206:             ServerStatus = "Онлайн (Ядро перезапущено)";
207:         }
208:         catch (Exception ex)
209:         {
210:             ServerStatus = "Ошибка перезапуска ядра";
211:             _logger.Log("RESTART-ERROR", ex.Message);
212:         }
213:     }
214: 
215:     [RelayCommand]
216:     private async Task RebootServerAsync()
217:     {
218:         var ssh = _currentMonitoringSsh;
219:         if (ssh == null || !ssh.IsConnected) return;
220: 
221:         // ВНЕДРЕНО: Строгая защита от случайного ребута физического сервера
222:         var result = System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
223:             "ВНИМАНИЕ! Это полностью перезагрузит физический сервер.\nСвязь с панелью будет потеряна на 1-3 минуты. Продолжить?",
224:             "Перезагрузка сервера", System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.YesNo, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
225: 
226:         if (result != System.Windows.MessageBoxResult.Yes) return;
227: 
228:         try
229:         {
230:             ServerStatus = "Отправка команды reboot...";
231:             _logger.Log("SYSTEM", $"Инициирована физическая перезагрузка сервера {SelectedServer?.IpAddress}");
232: 
233:             // ВНЕДРЕНО: Fire-and-forget выполнение.
234:             // Мы не делаем await для завершения команды, так как сервер умрет мгновенно
235:             // и SSH.NET выкинет SocketException из-за обрыва соединения.
236:             _ = ssh.ExecuteCommandAsync("reboot");
237: 
238:             // Ждем 1 секунду, чтобы пакет успел уйти в сокет
239:             await Task.Delay(1000);
240:         }
241:         catch
242:         {
243:             // Ожидаемый обрыв связи игнорируется
244:         }
245:         finally
246:         {
247:             ServerStatus = "Сервер ушел в перезагрузку (Offline)";
248:             StopMonitoring();
249:             ssh.Disconnect();
250:             if (_currentMonitoringSsh == ssh) _currentMonitoringSsh = null;
251:         }
252:     }
253: }

 45:     }

 47:     [RelayCommand]
 48:     private void GenerateUuid()
 49:     {
 50:         Uuid = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
 51:         StatusMessage = "✅ Новый UUID успешно сгенерирован!";
 52:         IsError = false;
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     [RelayCommand]
 56:     private void ApplyConfig()
 57:     {
 58:         if (!ValidateFoolproof()) return;
 59: 
 60:         // Здесь будет логика применения твоей конфигурации
 61:         StatusMessage = "🚀 КОНФИГУРАЦИЯ ИДЕАЛЬНА! Подготовка к отправке на сервер...";
 62:         IsError = false;
 63:     }
 64: 
 65:     [RelayCommand]
 66:     private void Cancel() => CloseAction?.Invoke();
 67: 
 68:     // УМНАЯ ЗАЩИТА ОТ ДУРАКА (Foolproof)
 69:     private bool ValidateFoolproof()
 70:     {
 71:         // 1. Проверка порта (Только числа от 1 до 65535)
 72:         if (!int.TryParse(Port, out int portNum) || portNum < 1 || portNum > 65535)
 73:         {
 74:             ShowError("ОШИБКА: Порт должен быть числом от 1 до 65535!");
 75:             return false;
 76:         }
 77: 
 78:         // 2. Проверка UUID (Строгий формат 8-4-4-4-12)
 79:         if (!Guid.TryParse(Uuid, out _))
 80:         {
 81:             ShowError("ОШИБКА: Неверный формат UUID! Нажмите кнопку генерации.");
 82:             return false;
 83:         }
 84: 
 85:         // 3. Проверка Short ID (Только HEX символы, максимум 16 знаков)
 86:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ShortId) || !Regex.IsMatch(ShortId, "^[0-9a-fA-F]+$") || ShortId.Length > 16)
 87:         {
 88:             ShowError("ОШИБКА: Short ID должен состоять только из HEX-символов (0-9, a-f)!");
 89:             return false;
 90:         }
 91: 
 92:         // 4. Проверка SNI
 93:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SniInput))
 94:         {
 95:             ShowError("ОШИБКА: Укажите SNI для маскировки!");
 96:             return false;
 97:         }
 98: 
 99:         return true;
100:     }
101: 
102:     private void ShowError(string msg)
103:     {
104:         StatusMessage = msg;
105:         IsError = true;
106:     }
107: }

 22: [SupportedOSPlatform("windows")]
 23: public partial class ProtocolSetupItem : ObservableObject
 24: {
 25:     public IProtocolBuilder Builder { get; }
 26: 
 27:     [ObservableProperty] private bool _isSelected;
 28:     [ObservableProperty] private string _portText = "";
 29:     [ObservableProperty] private bool _isValid = true;
 30:     [ObservableProperty] private string _validationMessage = "Ожидание...";
 31: 
 32:     [ObservableProperty] private string _ttUsername = "ADMIN";
 33:     [ObservableProperty] private string _ttPassword = "";
 34: 
 35:     public bool IsTrustTunnel => Builder.ProtocolType.Equals("trusttunnel", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
 36: 
 37:     public ProtocolSetupItem(IProtocolBuilder builder, string existingAdminUuid = "")
 38:     {
 39:         Builder = builder;
 40: 
 41:         if (IsTrustTunnel)
 42:         {
 43:             // Умный UI: Если в базе уже есть UUID, показываем его. Если сервер чистый - генерируем.
 44:             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(existingAdminUuid))
 45:             {
 46:                 TtPassword = existingAdminUuid;
 47:             }
 48:             else
 49:             {
 50:                 GenerateTtPassword();
 51:             }
 52:         }
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     [CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input.RelayCommand]
 56:     private void GenerateTtPassword()
 57:     {
 58:         const string chars = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789!@#$%^&*";
 59:         var random = new Random();
 60:         TtPassword = new string(Enumerable.Repeat(chars, 16).Select(s => s[random.Next(s.Length)]).ToArray());
 61:     }
 62: }

 85:     [ObservableProperty] private string _statusMessage = "Выберите ядро и нужные протоколы для установки.";

 87:     public ObservableCollection<ProtocolSetupItem> AvailableProtocols { get; } = new();
 88: 
 89:     public DeployWizardViewModel(
 90:         ISshService ssh,
 91:         ProtocolFactory protocolFactory,
 92:         ISmartPortValidator portValidator,
 93:         IAppLogger logger,
 94:         ICoreDeploymentService deploymentService,
 95:         IProfileRepository profileRepository,
 96:         IServerSelectionService serverSelectionService)
 97:     {
 98:         _ssh = ssh;
 99:         _protocolFactory = protocolFactory;
100:         _portValidator = portValidator;
101:         _logger = logger;
102:         _deploymentService = deploymentService;
103:         _profileRepository = profileRepository;
104:         _serverSelectionService = serverSelectionService;
105:     }
106: 
107:     public async Task InitializeAsync(VpnProfile server)
108:     {
109:         _logger.Log("WIZARD-TRACE", $"[START] Инициализация мастера для сервера {server.IpAddress}");
110:         _server = server;
111: 
112:         try
113:         {
114:             if (!_ssh.IsConnected)
115:             {
116:                 _logger.Log("WIZARD-TRACE", "[INFO] SSH не подключен. Начинаем подключение...");
117:                 StatusMessage = "Подключение к серверу для умного сканирования портов...";
118: 
119:                 var connectResult = await _ssh.ConnectAsync(server.IpAddress!, server.Port, server.Username!, server.Password!, server.KeyPath!);
120:                 _logger.Log("WIZARD-TRACE", $"[SSH] Результат подключения: {connectResult}");
121:             }
122: 
123:             LoadProtocolsForCurrentCore();
124:             StatusMessage = "Успешно! Выберите ядро и отметьте протоколы.";
125:             _logger.Log("WIZARD-TRACE", "[SUCCESS] Мастер загружен.");
126:         }
127:         catch (Exception ex)
128:         {
129:             _logger.Log("WIZARD-ERROR", $"[ОШИБКА] {ex.Message}");
130:             StatusMessage = $"Ошибка подключения: {ex.Message}";
131:         }
132:     }
133: 
134:     partial void OnIsXraySelectedChanged(bool value)
135:     {
136:         if (value) { IsSingBoxSelected = false; IsTrustTunnelSelected = false; LoadProtocolsForCurrentCore(); }
137:     }
138: 
139:     partial void OnIsSingBoxSelectedChanged(bool value)
140:     {
141:         if (value) { IsXraySelected = false; IsTrustTunnelSelected = false; LoadProtocolsForCurrentCore(); }
142:     }
143: 
144:     partial void OnIsTrustTunnelSelectedChanged(bool value)
145:     {
146:         if (value) { IsXraySelected = false; IsSingBoxSelected = false; LoadProtocolsForCurrentCore(); }
147:     }
148: 
149:     private string GetSelectedCoreType()
150:     {
151:         if (IsSingBoxSelected) return CoreTypes.SingBox;
152:         if (IsTrustTunnelSelected) return CoreTypes.TrustTunnel;
153:         return CoreTypes.Xray;
154:     }
155: 
156:     private void LoadProtocolsForCurrentCore()
157:     {
158:         foreach (var p in AvailableProtocols) p.PropertyChanged -= OnProtocolPropertyChanged;
159:         AvailableProtocols.Clear();
160: 
161:         if (IsCustomSelected) return;
162: 
163:         // === ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Получаем реальный UUID из базы, чтобы UI не врал ===
164:         string existingAdminUuid = "";
165:         if (_server != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_server.IpAddress))
166:         {
167:             try
168:             {
169:                 using (var db = new KoFFPanel.Infrastructure.Data.AppDbContext())
170:                 {
171:                     var admin = db.Clients.FirstOrDefault(c => c.ServerIp == _server.IpAddress && c.Email == "ADMIN");
172:                     if (admin != null) existingAdminUuid = admin.Uuid;
173:                 }
174:             }
175:             catch { }
176:         }
177:         // ====================================================================
178: 
179:         var builders = _protocolFactory.GetAvailableProtocols(GetSelectedCoreType());
180:         foreach (var builder in builders)
181:         {
182:             // Передаем реальный UUID в элемент UI
183:             var item = new ProtocolSetupItem(builder, existingAdminUuid);
184: 
185:             if (_server?.Inbounds != null)
186:             {
187:                 var existing = _server.Inbounds.FirstOrDefault(i => i.Protocol.Equals(builder.ProtocolType, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
188:                 if (existing != null)
189:                 {
190:                     item.IsSelected = false;
191:                     item.PortText = existing.Port.ToString();
192:                     item.IsValid = true;
193:                     item.ValidationMessage = "Установлен (Включите для переустановки)";
194:                 }
195:                 else if (builder.ProtocolType.Equals("trusttunnel", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
196:                 {
197:                     item.PortText = "5443";
198:                 }
199:             }
200: 
201:             item.PropertyChanged += OnProtocolPropertyChanged;
202:             AvailableProtocols.Add(item);
203:         }
204:     }
205: 
206:     private async void OnProtocolPropertyChanged(object? sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
207:     {
208:         if (sender is ProtocolSetupItem item)
209:         {
210:             if (e.PropertyName == nameof(ProtocolSetupItem.IsSelected))
211:             {
212:                 if (item.IsSelected)
213:                 {
214:                     item.ValidationMessage = "Сканирование...";
215:                     item.IsValid = true;
216: 
217:                     int bestPort = int.TryParse(item.PortText, out int parsedPort) ? parsedPort :
218:                         await _portValidator.SuggestBestPortAsync(_ssh, _server.Id, item.Builder.ProtocolType);
219: 
220:                     string newPortText = bestPort.ToString();
221: 
222:                     if (item.PortText == newPortText)
223:                     {
224:                         item.ValidationMessage = "Проверка...";
225:                         var (isValid, msg) = await _portValidator.ValidatePortAsync(_ssh, _server.Id, bestPort, item.Builder.ProtocolType);
226: 
227:                         var duplicateInUI = AvailableProtocols.FirstOrDefault(p => p != item && p.IsSelected && p.PortText == newPortText && p.Builder.TransportType == item.Builder.TransportType);
228:                         if (duplicateInUI != null)
229:                         {
230:                             isValid = false;
231:                             msg = $"Конфликт UI: Порт уже выбран для {duplicateInUI.Builder.DisplayName}!";
232:                         }
233: 
234:                         item.IsValid = isValid;
235:                         item.ValidationMessage = msg;
236:                     }
237:                     else
238:                     {
239:                         item.PortText = newPortText;
240:                     }
241:                 }
242:                 else
243:                 {
244:                     item.PortText = "";
245:                     item.ValidationMessage = "ОТКЛЮЧЕН";
246:                 }
247:             }
248:             else if (e.PropertyName == nameof(ProtocolSetupItem.PortText) && item.IsSelected)
249:             {
250:                 if (int.TryParse(item.PortText, out int port))
251:                 {
252:                     item.ValidationMessage = "Проверка...";
253:                     var (isValid, msg) = await _portValidator.ValidatePortAsync(_ssh, _server.Id, port, item.Builder.ProtocolType);
254: 
255:                     var duplicateInUI = AvailableProtocols.FirstOrDefault(p => p != item && p.IsSelected && p.PortText == item.PortText && p.Builder.TransportType == item.Builder.TransportType);
256:                     if (duplicateInUI != null)
257:                     {
258:                         isValid = false;
259:                         msg = $"Конфликт UI: Порт уже выбран для {duplicateInUI.Builder.DisplayName}!";
260:                     }
261: 
262:                     item.IsValid = isValid;
263:                     item.ValidationMessage = msg;
264:                 }
265:                 else
266:                 {
267:                     item.IsValid = false;
268:                     item.ValidationMessage = "Введите число от 1 до 65535";
269:                 }
270:             }
271:         }
272:     }
273: 
274:     [RelayCommand]
275:     private void Cancel() => CloseAction?.Invoke();
276: 
277:     [RelayCommand]
278:     private async Task StartInstallAsync()
279:     {
280:         _logger.Log("WIZARD-TRACE", "[ACTION] Старт установки");
281: 
282:         if (IsCustomSelected) return;
283: 
284:         var selectedItems = AvailableProtocols.Where(p => p.IsSelected).ToList();
285:         if (!selectedItems.Any())
286:         {
287:             StatusMessage = "ОШИБКА: Выберите протоколы!";
288:             return;
289:         }
290:         if (selectedItems.Any(p => !p.IsValid))
291:         {
292:             StatusMessage = "ОШИБКА: Исправьте конфликты портов!";
293:             return;
294:         }
295: 
296:         var allServers = _profileRepository.LoadProfiles();
297: 
298:         if (allServers.Count == 0)
299:         {
300:             StatusMessage = "ОШИБКА: Нет доступных серверов для установки!";
301:             return;
302:         }
303:         else if (allServers.Count > 1)
304:         {
305:             var targetServer = _serverSelectionService.SelectServer(allServers, _server);
306: 
307:             if (targetServer != null)
308:             {
309:                 if (_server.Id != targetServer.Id)
310:                 {
311:                     bool revalidationPassed = await SwitchServerAndRevalidateAsync(targetServer, selectedItems);
312:                     if (!revalidationPassed) return;
313:                 }
314:             }
315:             else
316:             {
317:                 StatusMessage = "Установка отменена пользователем.";
318:                 return;
319:             }
320:         }
321: 
322:         // === ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Обязательный Guard Clause (Pre-flight check) ===
323:         StatusMessage = "Проверка прав доступа (Pre-flight check)...";
324:         var preFlight = await _deploymentService.RunPreFlightChecksAsync(_ssh);
325:         if (!preFlight.IsSuccess)
326:         {
327:             StatusMessage = $"ОШИБКА: {preFlight.Message}";
328:             _logger.Log("WIZARD-ERROR", $"[PRE-FLIGHT FAIL] {preFlight.Message}");
329:             return; // Жестко прерываем установку, так как прав нет
330:         }
331:         // ================================================================
332: 
333:         StatusMessage = "🚀 Развертывание ядра и портов... (Подождите)";
334:         IsNotInstalling = false;
335: 
336:         var protocolsToInstall = selectedItems.Select(p => (p.Builder, int.Parse(p.PortText), p.IsTrustTunnel ? p.TtUsername : null, p.IsTrustTunnel ? p.TtPassword : null)).ToList();
337: 
338:         var (success, log) = await _deploymentService.DeployFullStackAsync(_ssh, _server, GetSelectedCoreType(), protocolsToInstall);
339: 
340:         if (success)
341:         {
342:             StatusMessage = "✅ УСТАНОВКА УСПЕШНА! Синхронизация клиентов...";
343:             _logger.Log("WIZARD-TRACE", "[SUCCESS] Отправка сигнала CabinetViewModel для вшивки клиентов.");
344: 
345:             WeakReferenceMessenger.Default.Send(new CoreDeployedMessage(_server));
346: 
347:             await Task.Delay(2000);
348:             CloseAction?.Invoke();
349:         }
350:         else
351:         {
352:             StatusMessage = "❌ ОШИБКА. Смотрите логи.";
353:             _logger.Log("WIZARD-ERROR", $"[DEPLOY-FAIL] {log}");
354:             IsNotInstalling = true;
355:         }
356:     }
357: 
358:     // === УМНЫЙ АЛГОРИТМ ПОВТОРНОЙ ВАЛИДАЦИИ (ЗАЩИТА ОТ ДУРАКА) ===
359:     private async Task<bool> SwitchServerAndRevalidateAsync(VpnProfile targetServer, List<ProtocolSetupItem> selectedItems)
360:     {
361:         StatusMessage = $"Подключение к {targetServer.IpAddress}...";
362:         _logger.Log("WIZARD-TRACE", $"[INFO] Изменен целевой сервер. Переподключение к {targetServer.IpAddress}");
363: 
364:         if (_ssh is IDisposable disposableDisconnect)
365:         {
366:             disposableDisconnect.Dispose();
367:         }
368: 
369:         var connectResult = await _ssh.ConnectAsync(targetServer.IpAddress!, targetServer.Port, targetServer.Username!, targetServer.Password!, targetServer.KeyPath ?? string.Empty);
370: 
371:         if (connectResult != "SUCCESS")
372:         {
373:             StatusMessage = $"Ошибка подключения к выбранному серверу: {connectResult}";
374:             return false;
375:         }
376: 
377:         _server = targetServer; // Жестко привязываем новый сервер к процессу установки
378: 
379:         StatusMessage = "Повторная проверка портов на новом сервере...";
380:         bool hasConflicts = false;
381: 
382:         // Прогоняем каждый выбранный протокол через валидатор уже на новом SSH соединении
383:         foreach (var item in selectedItems)
384:         {
385:             item.ValidationMessage = "Проверка на новом сервере...";
386:             int port = int.Parse(item.PortText);
387: 
388:             var (isValid, msg) = await _portValidator.ValidatePortAsync(_ssh, _server.Id, port, item.Builder.ProtocolType);
389: 
390:             item.IsValid = isValid;
391:             item.ValidationMessage = msg;
392: 
393:             if (!isValid)
394:             {
395:                 hasConflicts = true;
396:             }
397:         }
398: 
399:         if (hasConflicts)
400:         {
401:             StatusMessage = "ОШИБКА: На выбранном сервере есть конфликты портов!";
402:             _logger.Log("WIZARD-WARN", "[WARN] Обнаружены конфликты портов после смены сервера. Установка прервана.");
403:             return false;
404:         }
405: 
406:         return true;
407:     }
408: 
409:     public void Dispose()
410:     {
411:         // ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Безопасное приведение типа интерфейса к IDisposable
412:         if (_ssh != null && _ssh.IsConnected)
413:         {
414:             if (_ssh is IDisposable disposableSsh)
415:             {
416:                 disposableSsh.Dispose();
417:                 _logger.Log("WIZARD-TRACE", "[INFO] SSH соединение мастера развертывания успешно закрыто.");
418:             }
419:         }
420:     }
421: }

 1: using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
 2: using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input;
 3: using System;
 4: using System.Runtime.Versioning;
 5: 
 6: namespace KoFFPanel.Presentation.Features.Management;
 7: 
 8: [SupportedOSPlatform("windows")]
 9: public partial class AddClientViewModel : ObservableObject
10: {
11:     [ObservableProperty] private string _clientName = "";
12:     [ObservableProperty] private int _trafficLimitGb = 0;
13:     [ObservableProperty] private DateTime? _expiryDate = null;
14:     [ObservableProperty] private string _note = "";
15: 
16:     // Флаги протоколов (СТАРЫЕ - НЕ ТРОГАЕМ)
17:     [ObservableProperty] private bool _isVlessEnabled = true;
18:     [ObservableProperty] private bool _isHysteria2Enabled = true;
19:     [ObservableProperty] private bool _isTrustTunnelEnabled = true;
20: 
21:     // НОВЫЕ СВОЙСТВА
22:     [ObservableProperty] private bool _isTrojanEnabled = false;
23:     [ObservableProperty] private bool _isShadowsocksEnabled = false;
24: 
25:     [ObservableProperty] private bool _isP2PBlocked = true;
26: 
27:     [ObservableProperty] private string _windowTitle = "Добавить пользователя";
28:     [ObservableProperty] private string _actionButtonText = "Создать";
29: 
30:     public bool IsEditMode { get; private set; } = false;
31:     public bool IsSuccess { get; private set; } = false;
32:     public Action? CloseAction { get; set; }
33: 
34:     public void Initialize(string serverIp)
35:     {
36:         IsEditMode = false;
37:         WindowTitle = "Добавить пользователя";
38:         ActionButtonText = "Создать";
39:         ClientName = "";
40:         TrafficLimitGb = 0;
41:         ExpiryDate = DateTime.Now.AddMonths(1);
42:         Note = "";
43:         IsP2PBlocked = true;
44: 
45:         IsVlessEnabled = true;
46:         IsHysteria2Enabled = true;
47:         IsTrustTunnelEnabled = true;
48:         IsTrojanEnabled = false;
49:         IsShadowsocksEnabled = false;
50:     }
51: 
52:     public void LoadForEdit(string currentName, long currentLimitBytes, DateTime? currentExpiry, string currentNote,
53:                            bool isP2pBlocked = true, bool isVless = true, bool isHy2 = false, bool isTt = false,
54:                            bool isTrojan = false, bool isShadowsocks = false)
55:     {
56:         IsEditMode = true;
57:         WindowTitle = "Редактировать пользователя";
58:         ActionButtonText = "Сохранить";
59: 
60:         ClientName = currentName;
61:         TrafficLimitGb = (int)(currentLimitBytes / 1024 / 1024 / 1024);
62:         ExpiryDate = currentExpiry;
63:         Note = currentNote ?? "";
64:         IsP2PBlocked = isP2pBlocked;
65: 
66:         IsVlessEnabled = isVless;
67:         IsHysteria2Enabled = isHy2;
68:         IsTrustTunnelEnabled = isTt;
69:         IsTrojanEnabled = isTrojan;
70:         IsShadowsocksEnabled = isShadowsocks;
71:     }
72: 
73:     [RelayCommand]
74:     private void Save()
75:     {
76:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ClientName)) return;
77: 
78:         IsSuccess = true;
79:         CloseAction?.Invoke();
80:     }
81: 
82:     [RelayCommand]
83:     private void Cancel()
84:     {
85:         IsSuccess = false;
86:         CloseAction?.Invoke();
87:     }
88: }

File: KoFFPanel.Presentation/Features/Management/AddServerViewModel.cs
================
  1: using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
  2: using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input;
  3: using KoFFPanel.Application.Interfaces;
  4: using KoFFPanel.Domain.Entities;
  5: using MaxMind.GeoIP2;
  6: using System;
  7: using System.IO;
  8: using System.Linq;
  9: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 10: 
 11: using System.Runtime.Versioning;
 12: 
 13: namespace KoFFPanel.Presentation.Features.Management;
 14: 
 15: [SupportedOSPlatform("windows")]
 16: public partial class AddServerViewModel : ObservableObject
 17: {
 18:     private readonly IProfileRepository _profileRepository;
 19:     private readonly ISshService _sshService;
 20:     private readonly IFilePickerService _filePickerService;
 21: 
 22:     public Action? CloseAction { get; set; }
 23: 
 24:     [ObservableProperty] private string _windowTitle = "Добавление сервера";
 25:     public bool IsEditMode { get; private set; } = false;
 26:     private string _editingServerId = string.Empty;
 27: 
 28:     [ObservableProperty] private string _name = "Новый сервер";
 29:     [ObservableProperty] private string _ipAddress = "";
 30:     [ObservableProperty] private int _port = 22;
 31:     [ObservableProperty] private string _username = "root";
 32:     [ObservableProperty] private string _password = "";
 33:     [ObservableProperty] private string _keyPath = "";
 34: 
 35:     [ObservableProperty] private string _customDomain = "";
 36:     [ObservableProperty] private string _connectionNode = "";
 37: 
 38:     [ObservableProperty] private string _statusMessage = "";
 39: 
 40:     [ObservableProperty] private bool _isChecking = false;
 41:     [ObservableProperty] private bool _isNotChecking = true;
 42: 
 43:     public AddServerViewModel(
 44:         IProfileRepository profileRepository,
 45:         ISshService sshService,
 46:         IFilePickerService filePickerService)
 47:     {
 48:         _profileRepository = profileRepository;
 49:         _sshService = sshService;
 50:         _filePickerService = filePickerService;
 51:     }
 52: 
 53:     public void LoadForEdit(VpnProfile profile)
 54:     {
 55:         IsEditMode = true;
 56:         WindowTitle = "Редактирование сервера";
 57:         _editingServerId = profile.Id ?? string.Empty;
 58: 
 59:         Name = profile.Name ?? "Новый сервер";
 60:         IpAddress = profile.IpAddress ?? string.Empty;
 61:         Port = profile.Port;
 62:         Username = profile.Username ?? "root";
 63:         Password = profile.Password ?? string.Empty;
 64:         KeyPath = profile.KeyPath ?? string.Empty;
 65:         Username = profile.Username ?? "root";
 66:         Password = profile.Password ?? string.Empty;
 67:         KeyPath = profile.KeyPath ?? string.Empty;
 68:         CustomDomain = profile.CustomDomain ?? string.Empty;
 69:         ConnectionNode = profile.ConnectionNode ?? string.Empty;
 70:     }
 71: 
 72:     [RelayCommand]
 73:     private void BrowseKey()
 74:     {
 75:         var path = _filePickerService.PickSshKeyFile();
 76:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
 77:         {
 78:             KeyPath = path;
 79:         }
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     [RelayCommand]
 83:     private void ClearKey()
 84:     {
 85:         KeyPath = string.Empty;
 86:     }
 87: 
 88:     [RelayCommand]
 89:     private async Task CheckConnectionAsync()
 90:     {
 91:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(IpAddress))
 92:         {
 93:             StatusMessage = "Введите IP-адрес!";
 94:             return;
 95:         }
 96: 
 97:         IsChecking = true;
 98:         IsNotChecking = false;
 99:         StatusMessage = "Проверка подключения (до 15 сек)...";
100: 
101:         string result = await _sshService.ConnectAsync(IpAddress, Port, Username, Password, KeyPath);
102: 
103:         if (result == "SUCCESS")
104:         {
105:             StatusMessage = "✅ Успешно! Сервер доступен.";
106:             _sshService.Disconnect();
107:         }
108:         else
109:         {
110:             StatusMessage = $"❌ Ошибка: {result}";
111:         }
112: 
113:         IsChecking = false;
114:         IsNotChecking = true;
115:     }
116: 
117:     [RelayCommand]
118:     private void Save()
119:     {
120:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(IpAddress) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Name))
121:         {
122:             StatusMessage = "Заполните Название и IP-адрес!";
123:             return;
124:         }
125: 
126:         string cleanIp = IpAddress.Trim();
127:         VpnProfile profileToSave;
128: 
129:         if (IsEditMode)
130:         {
131:             var existingProfile = _profileRepository.LoadProfiles().FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == _editingServerId);
132:             profileToSave = existingProfile ?? new VpnProfile { Id = _editingServerId };
133:             
134:             profileToSave.Name = Name;
135:             profileToSave.IpAddress = cleanIp;
136:             profileToSave.Port = Port <= 0 ? 22 : Port;
137:             profileToSave.Username = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Username) ? "root" : Username;
138:             profileToSave.Password = Password ?? string.Empty;
139:             profileToSave.KeyPath = KeyPath ?? string.Empty;
140:             profileToSave.CustomDomain = CustomDomain?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
141:             profileToSave.ConnectionNode = ConnectionNode?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
142:             
143:             _profileRepository.UpdateProfile(profileToSave);
144:         }
145:         else
146:         {
147:             profileToSave = new VpnProfile
148:             {
149:                 Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
150:                 Name = Name,
151:                 IpAddress = cleanIp,
152:                 Port = Port <= 0 ? 22 : Port,
153:                 Username = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Username) ? "root" : Username,
154:                 Password = Password ?? string.Empty,
155:                 KeyPath = KeyPath ?? string.Empty,
156:                 CustomDomain = CustomDomain?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
157:                 ConnectionNode = ConnectionNode?.Trim() ?? string.Empty
158:             };
159:             _profileRepository.AddProfile(profileToSave);
160:         }
161: 
162:         CloseAction?.Invoke();
163:     }
164: 
165:     [RelayCommand]
166:     private void Cancel()
167:     {
168:         CloseAction?.Invoke();
169:     }
170: }

 47:     [ObservableProperty] private bool _isTrustTunnelCopied;

 73:     public ClientProtocolsViewModel(IProfileRepository profileRepository, ISshService ssh, IFilePickerService filePicker)
 74:     {
 75:         _profileRepository = profileRepository;
 76:         _ssh = ssh;
 77:         _filePicker = filePicker;
 78:     }
 79: 
 80:     public void Initialize(VpnClient client, string httpLink)
 81:     {
 82:         _originalClient = client;
 83:         Email = client.Email;
 84:         WindowTitle = $"Протоколы: {client.Email}";
 85:         IsAdmin = client.Email.Equals("ADMIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
 86:         TtServerAddress = client.ServerIp;
 87:         HttpLink = httpLink;
 88: 
 89:         var profile = _profileRepository.LoadProfiles().FirstOrDefault(p => p.IpAddress == client.ServerIp);
 90:         profile?.MigrateLegacyData();
 91:         var inbounds = profile?.Inbounds ?? new System.Collections.Generic.List<ServerInbound>();
 92: 
 93:         bool serverHasVless = inbounds.Any(i => i.Protocol.Equals("vless", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
 94:         bool serverHasHysteria = inbounds.Any(i => i.Protocol.Equals("hysteria2", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
 95:         bool serverHasTrustTunnel = inbounds.Any(i => i.Protocol.Equals("trusttunnel", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
 96:         bool serverHasTrojan = inbounds.Any(i => i.Protocol.Equals("trojan", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
 97:         bool serverHasShadowsocks = inbounds.Any(i => i.Protocol.Equals("shadowsocks", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
 98: 
 99:         SupportsVless = serverHasVless;
100:         SupportsHysteria2 = serverHasHysteria;
101:         SupportsTrustTunnel = serverHasTrustTunnel;
102:         SupportsTrojan = serverHasTrojan;
103:         SupportsShadowsocks = serverHasShadowsocks;
104: 
105:         IsTrustTunnelMode = serverHasTrustTunnel && !serverHasVless && !serverHasHysteria && !serverHasTrojan && !serverHasShadowsocks;
106: 
107:         IsVlessEnabled = client.IsVlessEnabled && serverHasVless;
108:         IsHysteria2Enabled = client.IsHysteria2Enabled && serverHasHysteria;
109:         IsTrustTunnelEnabled = client.IsTrustTunnelEnabled && serverHasTrustTunnel;
110:         IsTrojanEnabled = client.IsTrojanEnabled && serverHasTrojan;
111:         IsShadowsocksEnabled = client.IsShadowsocksEnabled && serverHasShadowsocks;
112: 
113:         VlessLink = client.VlessLink;
114:         Hysteria2Link = client.Hysteria2Link;
115:         TrustTunnelLink = client.TrustTunnelLink;
116:         TrojanLink = client.TrojanLink;
117:         ShadowsocksLink = client.ShadowsocksLink;
118: 
119:         if (serverHasVless && (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(VlessLink) || VlessLink.Contains("не установлен")))
120:             VlessLink = GenerateVlessLinkFallback(inbounds.First(i => i.Protocol.Equals("vless", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)), client.ServerIp, client.Uuid, client.Email);
121: 
122:         if (serverHasHysteria && (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Hysteria2Link) || Hysteria2Link.Contains("не установлен")))
123:             Hysteria2Link = GenerateHysteriaLinkFallback(inbounds.First(i => i.Protocol.Equals("hysteria2", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)), client.ServerIp, client.Uuid, client.Email);
124: 
125:         if (serverHasTrustTunnel && (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(TrustTunnelLink) || TrustTunnelLink.Contains("не установлен")))
126:             TrustTunnelLink = GenerateTrustTunnelLinkFallback(inbounds.First(i => i.Protocol.Equals("trusttunnel", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)), client.ServerIp, client.Uuid, client.Email);
127: 
128:         TtUsername = client.Email;
129:         TtPassword = client.Uuid;
130: 
131:         if (serverHasTrustTunnel)
132:         {
133:             ExtractTrustTunnelSettingsSafe(inbounds);
134:             var ttInbound = inbounds.FirstOrDefault(i => i.Protocol.Equals("trusttunnel", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
135:             if (ttInbound != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ttInbound.SettingsJson))
136:             {
137:                 try
138:                 {
139:                     var ttSettings = System.Text.Json.JsonDocument.Parse(ttInbound.SettingsJson).RootElement;
140:                     if (ttSettings.TryGetProperty("username", out var u)) TtUsername = u.GetString() ?? TtUsername;
141:                     if (ttSettings.TryGetProperty("password", out var p)) TtPassword = p.GetString() ?? TtPassword;
142:                 }
143:                 catch { }
144:             }
145:         }
146:         else SetDefaultTrustTunnelSettings();
147:     }
148: 
149:     private string GenerateVlessLinkFallback(ServerInbound inbound, string ip, string uuid, string email)
150:     {
151:         try
152:         {
153:             var settings = System.Text.Json.JsonDocument.Parse(inbound.SettingsJson).RootElement;
154:             string pub = settings.GetProperty("publicKey").GetString() ?? "";
155:             string sni = settings.GetProperty("sni").GetString() ?? "google.com";
156:             string sid = settings.GetProperty("shortId").GetString() ?? "";
157:             string safeIp = ip.Contains(":") && !ip.StartsWith("[") ? $"[{ip}]" : ip;
158:             return $"vless://{uuid}@{safeIp}:{inbound.Port}?type=tcp&security=reality&pbk={pub}&fp=chrome&sni={sni}&sid={sid}&spx=%2F&flow=xtls-rprx-vision&alpn=h2#KoFF_{email}";
159:         }
160:         catch { return "Ошибка генерации ссылки"; }
161:     }
162: 
163:     private string GenerateHysteriaLinkFallback(ServerInbound inbound, string ip, string uuid, string email)
164:     {
165:         try
166:         {
167:             var settings = System.Text.Json.JsonDocument.Parse(inbound.SettingsJson).RootElement;
168:             string sni = settings.GetProperty("sni").GetString() ?? "bing.com";
169:             string obfs = settings.GetProperty("obfsPassword").GetString() ?? "";
170:             string safeIp = ip.Contains(":") && !ip.StartsWith("[") ? $"[{ip}]" : ip;
171:             string encodedName = Uri.EscapeDataString($"KoFF_{email}");
172:             return $"hy2://{uuid}@{safeIp}:{inbound.Port}?sni={sni}&obfs=salamander&obfs-password={obfs}&insecure=1#{encodedName}";
173:         }
174:         catch { return "Ошибка генерации ссылки"; }
175:     }
176: 
177:     private string GenerateTrustTunnelLinkFallback(ServerInbound inbound, string ip, string uuid, string email)
178:     {
179:         string safeIp = ip.Contains(":") && !ip.StartsWith("[") ? $"[{ip}]" : ip;
180:         return $"vless://{uuid}@{safeIp}:{inbound.Port}?type=xhttp&security=tls&sni=google.com&alpn=h3#TT_{email}";
181:     }
182: 
183:     private void ExtractTrustTunnelSettingsSafe(System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<ServerInbound> inbounds)
184:     {
185:         var ttInbound = inbounds.FirstOrDefault(i => i.Protocol.Equals("trusttunnel", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
186:         if (ttInbound is null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ttInbound.SettingsJson))
187:         {
188:             SetDefaultTrustTunnelSettings();
189:             return;
190:         }
191: 
192:         try
193:         {
194:             var ttSettings = System.Text.Json.JsonDocument.Parse(ttInbound.SettingsJson).RootElement;
195:             TtDomainName = ttSettings.GetProperty("sni").GetString() ?? "google.com";
196:             TtDnsServers = "8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1";
197:         }
198:         catch (System.Text.Json.JsonException)
199:         {
200:             SetDefaultTrustTunnelSettings();
201:         }
202:     }
203: 
204:     private void SetDefaultTrustTunnelSettings()
205:     {
206:         TtDomainName = "google.com";
207:         TtDnsServers = "8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1";
208:     }
209: 
210:     private async Task SafeCopyToClipboardAsync(string text)
211:     {
212:         for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
213:         {
214:             try
215:             {
216:                 System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() => Clipboard.SetText(text));
217:                 return;
218:             }
219:             catch (System.Runtime.InteropServices.COMException)
220:             {
221:                 await Task.Delay(20);
222:             }
223:         }
224:     }
225: 
226:     [RelayCommand] private async Task CopyTtPasswordAsync() { if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(TtPassword)) return; await SafeCopyToClipboardAsync(TtPassword); IsTrustTunnelCopied = true; await Task.Delay(2000); IsTrustTunnelCopied = false; }
227:     [RelayCommand] private async Task CopyHttpAsync() { if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(HttpLink)) return; await SafeCopyToClipboardAsync(HttpLink); IsHttpCopied = true; await Task.Delay(2000); IsHttpCopied = false; }
228:     [RelayCommand] private async Task CopyVlessAsync() { if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(VlessLink)) return; await SafeCopyToClipboardAsync(VlessLink); IsVlessCopied = true; await Task.Delay(2000); IsVlessCopied = false; }
229:     [RelayCommand] private async Task CopyHysteria2Async() { if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Hysteria2Link)) return; await SafeCopyToClipboardAsync(Hysteria2Link); IsHysteria2Copied = true; await Task.Delay(2000); IsHysteria2Copied = false; }
230:     [RelayCommand] private async Task CopyTrustTunnelAsync() { if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(TrustTunnelLink)) return; await SafeCopyToClipboardAsync(TrustTunnelLink); IsTrustTunnelCopied = true; await Task.Delay(2000); IsTrustTunnelCopied = false; }
231: 
232:     [RelayCommand] private async Task CopyTrojanAsync() { if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(TrojanLink)) return; await SafeCopyToClipboardAsync(TrojanLink); IsTrojanCopied = true; await Task.Delay(2000); IsTrojanCopied = false; }
233:     [RelayCommand] private async Task CopyShadowsocksAsync() { if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ShadowsocksLink)) return; await SafeCopyToClipboardAsync(ShadowsocksLink); IsShadowsocksCopied = true; await Task.Delay(2000); IsShadowsocksCopied = false; }
234: 
235:     [RelayCommand]
236:     private async Task DownloadCertAsync()
237:     {
238:         if (!IsAdmin || !_ssh.IsConnected) return;
239:         try
240:         {
241:             string? localPath = _filePicker.SaveFile("cert.pem", "PEM Certificate (*.pem)|*.pem|All files (*.*)|*.*");
242:             if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(localPath)) return;
243:             using (var localStream = System.IO.File.Create(localPath))
244:             {
245:                 await _ssh.DownloadFileAsync(TrustTunnelCertPath, localStream);
246:             }
247:             MessageBox.Show($"Файл успешно сохранен: {localPath}", "Успех", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
248:         }
249:         catch (Exception ex)
250:         {
251:             MessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при скачивании: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
252:         }
253:     }
254: 
255:     [RelayCommand]
256:     private void Save()
257:     {
258:         _originalClient.IsVlessEnabled = IsVlessEnabled;
259:         _originalClient.IsHysteria2Enabled = IsHysteria2Enabled;
260:         _originalClient.IsTrustTunnelEnabled = IsTrustTunnelEnabled;
261:         _originalClient.IsTrojanEnabled = IsTrojanEnabled;
262:         _originalClient.IsShadowsocksEnabled = IsShadowsocksEnabled;
263: 
264:         SaveCallback?.Invoke(_originalClient);
265:         CloseAction?.Invoke();
266:     }
267: 
268:     [RelayCommand]
269:     private void Cancel() => CloseAction?.Invoke();
270: }

 1: using KoFFPanel.Domain.Entities;
 2: using System.Collections.Generic;
 3: using System.Linq;
 4: using System.Windows;
 5: using System.Windows.Controls;
 6: using Wpf.Ui.Controls;
 7: 
 8: namespace KoFFPanel.Presentation.Features.Management;
 9: 
10: public partial class ServerSelectionWindow : FluentWindow
11: {
12:     public VpnProfile? SelectedServer { get; private set; }
13: 
14:     public ServerSelectionWindow(List<VpnProfile> servers, VpnProfile currentServer)
15:     {
16:         InitializeComponent();
17:         ServersList.ItemsSource = servers;
18: 
19:         var defaultSelection = servers.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Id == currentServer?.Id);
20:         if (defaultSelection != null)
21:         {
22:             ServersList.SelectedItem = defaultSelection;
23:         }
24:     }
25: 
26:     private void ServersList_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
27:     {
28:         ConfirmBtn.IsEnabled = ServersList.SelectedItem != null;
29:     }
30: 
31:     private void Cancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
32:     {
33:         DialogResult = false;
34:         Close();
35:     }
36: 
37:     private void Confirm_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
38:     {
39:         if (ServersList.SelectedItem is VpnProfile selected)
40:         {
41:             SelectedServer = selected;
42:             DialogResult = true;
43:             Close();
44:         }
45:     }
46: }
